About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with U.S. and Canadian companies looking for experienced remote talent. For this opportunity, we are recruiting for a U.S. personal injury law firm that values experienced people who can take ownership of their caseload, communicate reliably, and keep cases moving without constant oversight. HireHawk supports globally distributed professionals with clear role expectations and dedicated team coordination.

About the Role

As a Personal Injury Pre-Litigation Case Manager, you will independently manage assigned personal injury cases through the full pre-litigation lifecycle after initial intake. This is an experienced-hire position for someone who already understands what should happen next on a PI file and can take action without step-by-step direction.

You will own case progression from opening and insurance claim setup through treatment coordination, records collection, demand preparation, settlement progression, and closing. You will have meaningful autonomy over your caseload while working within an established legal team, with additional support available for areas such as lien reductions.

Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of assigned personal injury cases from post-intake opening through settlement and case closing
  • Open insurance claims, communicate with carriers, and obtain or confirm applicable policy limits
  • Coordinate medical treatment and help clients connect with appropriate providers or specialists based on their injuries and case needs
  • Monitor treatment progression and manage cases with awareness of available insurance coverage and policy limits
  • Request, gather, track, and review medical records, bills, insurance documents, and other supporting case materials
  • Proactively identify the next steps required on each file and keep cases progressing without unnecessary delays
  • Maintain consistent communication with clients, medical providers, insurance representatives, and internal team members
  • Prepare cases for demand by organizing supporting documentation and assisting with or drafting demand packages and letters
  • Support settlement progression, including matters involving policy-limit tenders, and ensure files are properly prepared for closing
  • Assist with lien reductions when needed, with additional firm support available for this function

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Prior hands-on U.S. personal injury pre-litigation case management experience
  • Strong working knowledge of the full personal injury pre-litigation lifecycle, with 3+ years of experience preferred
  • Proven ability to independently open, work up, progress, settle, and close personal injury cases
  • Experience opening insurance claims, investigating coverage, and obtaining or confirming policy limits
  • Strong knowledge of medical treatment coordination, medical records and bills, and ongoing case progression
  • Experience preparing PI cases for demand, including organizing documentation and assisting with or drafting demand packages
  • Strong written and verbal English, with the reliability and judgment to work independently with minimal supervision

Nice to Have:

  • Experience negotiating or assisting with lien reductions
  • Familiarity with Clio or another legal case-management platform
  • Experience handling policy-limit tenders and settlement documentation

Precision for Medicine is the first global precision medicine clinical research services organization, purpose-built to improve the clinical research and development process for new therapeutics. Our novel approach integrates clinical operations excellence, with laboratory expertise, and advanced data sciences to inform every step. We apply our expertise to trials at all stages—from early development through approval—with embedded experience in oncology and rare disease. With over 2000 dedicated professionals and 35 offices worldwide, we stand ready to help accelerate life-changing treatments anywhere around the globe. Won’t you join us today as a Manager, Account Development?

The focus of the Manager, Account Development is to increase market awareness, generate leads, and increase customer base for the Business Development Team.  This is achieved by a high degree of direct contact with prospective clients including by telephone, by email and direct mail. The duties also include assisting in developing and implementing strategies to facilitate long term relationship with new and existing clients.  

The Manager, Account Development will also work closely with the Business Development Leadership Team to establish and help implement and confirm “inside sales” best practices based on prior experience, available technologies and aligned to company goals. 

Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to:

  • Review current account development processes, messaging & technologies and recommend areas for improvement
  • Assist in establishing account development production expectations and metrics aligned to corporate goals

  • Using activity and results data create improved outreach messaging in an effort to increase client response and interactivity

  • Set-up meetings for BD representatives: regionally and at conferences etc. in coordination with Marketing department
  • Provide weekly, monthly and quarterly sales activity reports to review with Line Manager and Business Development executives.
  • Ensure all activity is recorded in Salesforce and HubSpot appropriately.
  • Mentor & train new members in the Inside Sales team.
  • Collaborate with appointed Business Development Mentor to develop
  • Other duties as assigned. (asdiscussed work with BD when appropriate on proposals to progress developing career towards BD).

Working Relationships:

  • Reports to the Business Development Leadership Team.
  • Collaborates closely with global Business Development Team
  • Liaises with all internal stakeholders within Contracts & Proposals, Clinical Operations and Marketing.
  • Collaborates closely with Inside Sales members
  • Ability to identify process efficiencies and make recommendations for improvement

Qualifications:

Minimum Required:

  • Bachelors, or equivalent level of experience, ideally in a business, scientific or healthcare discipline
  • Full Professional Proficiency in English

Other Required:

  • 5 years or more in the CRO/pharmaceutical industry
  • Availability for occasional domestic and international travel including overnight stays

Preferred:

  • Account development and sales experience
  • Postgraduate

Skills:

Competencies

  • Possesses a keen understanding of the Oncology and Rare Disease Development market and the role that Precision for Medicine plays in that environment
  • Resolves company and client related problems and prioritize workload to meet deadlines with little support from management
  • Exhibits high self-motivation, and is able to work and plan independently as well as in a team environment
  • Motivates other members of the company to meet timelines and company goals
  • Focuses on continuous improvement, including the ability to make proactive assessments on how to make processes more efficient and people more effective
  • Demonstrates a high degree of professionalism, as evidenced by ability to deliver on commitments, an understanding of the service culture and positive interactions with customers and teammates, including good interpersonal skills in the areas of diplomacy and negotiation
  • Communicates both verbally and in written form in an exemplary manner
  • Conducts formal presentations to a wide variety of audiences including colleagues, investigative staff, and clients with a high level of proficiency
  • Possesses practical knowledge of IT tools and systems in use in the company and on the project teams

Find your calling at Mercy!

Provides Behavioral Health services for callers to enhance their entrance into Mercy Health Care. Performs duties and responsibilities in a manner consistent with our mission, values, guiding principles, mercy standards and NASW Code of Ethics.

Position Details:

Behavioral Health Information & Referral Counselor (Nights)

Location: Mercy Virtual Care Center, Chesterfield, MO
Schedule: Full-Time Nights

Position Summary

The Behavioral Health Information & Referral Counselor serves as a critical first point of contact for individuals and families seeking behavioral health services. This role provides assessment, support, education, and referral coordination for callers experiencing mental health and behavioral health concerns. Through compassionate communication and clinical judgment, the counselor connects individuals with the most appropriate treatment resources while ensuring timely care coordination and follow-up.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator, skilled problem-solver, and compassionate advocate who can effectively assist individuals in crisis while navigating complex behavioral health systems and community resources.

Key Responsibilities

Patient & Family Support

  • Provide support, education, and guidance to patients, families, and community members seeking behavioral health services.
  • Assess callers' presenting concerns and identify appropriate treatment options and resources.
  • Educate individuals and families on recommended services, treatment programs, and next steps for care.
  • Follow up with high-risk callers and families to encourage connection with recommended services and resources.

Referral & Care Coordination

  • Coordinate assessments and admissions by communicating clinical and financial information to care teams, providers, and admitting physicians.
  • Connect callers with appropriate internal programs and community-based resources.
  • Facilitate transfers and ensure smooth care transitions when a higher level of care is needed.
  • Maintain strong relationships with community agencies and referral partners to support access to care.

Documentation & Communication

  • Accurately document patient information, presenting concerns, referral recommendations, insurance information, and referral sources.
  • Enter and maintain information within departmental databases and systems in a timely manner.
  • Ensure clear communication and handoff information for on-call staff and team members to support continuity of care.
  • Maintain confidentiality and compliance with all privacy regulations and organizational policies.

Quality & Professional Practice

  • Maintain current and accurate referral resource information, including program details, contact information, and insurance participation.
  • Manage calls efficiently while ensuring callers receive thorough support and guidance.
  • Adhere to all safety, infection prevention, patient rights, and regulatory requirements.
  • Participate in departmental initiatives and perform additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Required Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to assess, understand, and respond to behavioral health concerns with professionalism and empathy.
  • Excellent telephone assessment and customer service skills.
  • Knowledge of behavioral health services, levels of care, community resources, and insurance processes.
  • Ability to explain complex clinical and service information clearly to callers and families.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to prioritize multiple tasks and situations.
  • Ability to work independently and make sound decisions in both routine and complex situations.
  • Proficiency with computer systems, databases, and documentation platforms.

Why Join Us?

As a Behavioral Health Information & Referral Counselor, you'll play an essential role in helping individuals and families access the behavioral health care they need. You'll be part of a collaborative team dedicated to improving lives through compassionate support, timely intervention, and meaningful connections to treatment and community resources.

Why Mercy?

From day one, Mercy offers outstanding benefits - including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, tuition support, and matched retirement plans for team members working 32+ hours per pay period.

Join a caring, collaborative team where your voice matters. At Mercy, you'll help shape the future of healthcare through innovation, technology, and compassion. As we grow, you'll grow with us.

Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

Sales Director – Healthcare (Dental & Aesthetics)

Location: Remote US
Type: 100% New Business Development

Position Summary

The Sales Director is responsible for driving net-new customer acquisition within Jabil Healthcare, targeting top-tier dental, aesthetics, and adjacent healthcare companies. This is a pure hunter role, focused on landing new logos and building long-term strategic partnerships.

This role leads highly consultative, enterprise-level sales engagements with complex, multi-stakeholder decision processes. The Sales Director will build executive-level relationships and position Jabil as a preferred, long-term manufacturing partner by delivering end-to-end, vertically integrated solutions across the product lifecycle.

You will partner closely with Business Unit leadership and cross-functional teams including Operations, Engineering, Quality, Finance, and Legal to develop solutions, win new programs, and ensure successful execution.

What can you expect to do?

New Business Development & Strategy

  • Develop and execute a targeted sales strategy to acquire new customers across dental, orthodontics, aesthetics, and adjacent healthcare markets
  • Identify, qualify, and pursue high-value opportunities; drive deals from prospecting through close
  • Build and maintain C-level relationships within target accounts
  • Lead complex, consultative sales cycles focused on value creation and long-term partnerships
  • Partner with internal leadership to shape go-to-market strategy and win new business

Sales Execution & Commercial Leadership

  • Own the full sales lifecycle: prospecting, qualification, solution development, negotiation, and close
  • Lead executive-level presentations
  • Maintain clear visibility into pipeline, forecasts, and deal progression
  • Deliver against bookings targets with strong focus on profitability and return on investment

Solution Development & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Collaborate with the Business Unit, Engineering, Operations, and Supply Chain to design competitive offerings
  • Promote Jabil’s full capabilities, including:
    • PCBA and advanced electronics
    • Electromechanical and complex assembly
    • Precision injection molding and tooling
    • Device design, development, and prototyping (DFx, value engineering)
    • Automation, testing, and quality systems
    • Packaging, sterilization, and post-manufacturing services
  • Support seamless transition from deal closure to program launch

What is the experience needed to be successful in this role?

  • Bachelor’s degree required (Business, Engineering, or related field)
  • 8+ years total sales or business development experience
  • At least 5 years of sales/business development experience in contract manufacturing, OEM, or related industries, such as:
    • Electronics manufacturing (EMS)
    • Medical device manufacturing
    • Electromechanical or complex device assembly
  • Proven track record of landing net-new business and growing strategic accounts
  • Strong financial acumen, including pricing, margin management, and deal structuring
  • Demonstrated success leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles
  • Ability to engage and influence senior executives
  • Experience working cross-functionally in a matrixed organization
  • Willingness to travel ~30–40% (domestic and occasional international)

Benefits Package with Jabil

Along with growth, stability, and the opportunity to be challenged, Jabil offers a competitive benefits package that includes:

  • Paid Time Off
  • Tuition Reimbursement
  • Life, AD&D, and Disability Insurance
  • Commuter Benefits
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Pet Insurance
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Annual Merit Increases
  • Community Volunteer Opportunities

As the Product Marketing Manager for athenaOne, athenahealth's flagship offering, you will help shape and execute an always-on go-to-market strategy that strengthens how athenaOne is positioned, understood, and sold in market. Operating horizontally across the athenaOne portfolio, you will connect the stories and innovations across our products into a cohesive value proposition for the broader solution. You will independently lead go-to-market strategy and execution for key athenaOne initiatives while partnering with Product Marketing, Product, Sales, Segment Marketing, Sales Enablement, and other teams to bring our strategy to life.

This role is ideal for a product marketer who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, can turn strategic direction into tangible action, and is equally energized by developing a compelling story and understanding whether that story is working in market.

About the Team:

Product Marketing serves as the storytellers of the organization, translating customer, market, and product insights into strategies that drive business results.

Essential Job Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute GTM strategies for priority athenaOne initiatives, translating business objectives, customer needs, and market opportunities into clear plans and deliverables.

  • Partner across Product, Marketing, Sales, and other teams to drive cross-functional GTM execution and ensure stakeholders are aligned on objectives, timelines, messaging, and responsibilities.

  • Support the development and execution of an always-on athenaOne GTM approach that builds sustained market understanding and demand beyond individual product or feature launches.

  • Translate strategic direction and ambiguous business challenges into structured plans, recommendations, and action.

  • Develop compelling messaging, sales presentations, one-pagers, and other core collateral that clearly articulate athenaOne's value to target audiences.

  • Partner with Product Marketing Managers across Clinicals, Revenue Cycle Management, Patient Engagement, Platform, and other product areas to connect individual product stories into a cohesive athenaOne narrative.

  • Maintain a strong understanding of product innovation across the athenaOne portfolio and ensure priority features and capabilities are appropriately reflected in broader portfolio messaging and GTM strategies.

  • Collaborate with Sales Enablement and other marketing teams to translate positioning and messaging into effective commercial resources and programs.

  • Collaborate with Customer Advocacy and CSM teams to develop compelling year one customer stories / boomerang stories

Additional Job Responsibilities:

  • Regularly analyze seller feedback, customer and prospect conversations, win/loss insights, competitive intelligence, and commercial performance to identify opportunities to improve athenaOne positioning and GTM execution.

  • Conduct targeted research and analysis to investigate opportunities across the buyer journey and develop recommendations for addressing them.

  • Establish strong feedback loops with Sales and other commercial stakeholders to understand how athenaOne is being positioned in market, what is resonating, and where additional support or refinement is needed.

  • Support recurring commercial performance reviews and retrospectives, translating insights into clear recommendations and follow-up actions.

  • Deploy triannual release messaging updates across market-facing endpoints and sales assets.

Expected Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in product marketing with experience in healthcare technology.

  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing GTM strategies for complex B2B products, platforms, or portfolios.

  • Exceptional writing and storytelling skills, with demonstrated ability to translate complex products and concepts into clear, compelling messaging.

  • Strong project management and organizational skills, with the ability to independently move complex, cross-functional work forward.

  • Strong relationship-building and collaboration skills, with demonstrated ability to influence across Product, Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholder groups.

  • Ability to synthesize customer, market, competitive, and commercial insights into actionable recommendations.

  • Intellectual curiosity and strong judgment, with a track record of asking thoughtful questions and turning ambiguous direction into tangible outcomes.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment and motivated to grow as a strategic product marketer.

Expected Compensation

$116,000 - $196,000

The base salary range shown reflects the full range for this role from minimum to maximum. At athenahealth, base pay depends on multiple factors, including job-related experience, relevant knowledge and skills, how your qualifications compare to others in similar roles, and geographical market rates. Base pay is only one part of our competitive Total Rewards package - depending on role eligibility, we offer both short and long-term incentives by way of an annual discretionary bonus plan, variable compensation plan, and equity plans.

About athenahealth

Our vision:In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture:Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment:Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What we can do for you:

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative  workspaces  — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. While we know in-office collaboration is critical to our vision, we recognize that not all work needs to be done within an office environment, full-time. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Learn more about our culture and benefits here: athenahealth.com/careers

raw.description:
Sales Development Representative (SDR) – Outbound Sales & Lead Generation | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Sales Development Representative (SDR) to drive outbound sales, lead generation, and pipeline growth through strategic prospecting and high-volume outreach.

This is a hands-on outbound sales role for someone who is comfortable cold calling, prospecting, handling objections, and consistently booking qualified meetings.

You’ll identify target prospects, execute multi-channel outreach across phone, email, and LinkedIn, and create qualified opportunities for the sales team.

If you thrive in outbound sales, cold outreach, appointment setting, and KPI-driven environments, this role is built for you.

What You’ll Own

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Build targeted prospect lists using:
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
    • Apollo
    • ZoomInfo
    • Similar prospecting platforms
  • Research accounts and decision-makers to personalize outreach
  • Execute outbound campaigns across email, LinkedIn, and cold calling
  • Identify and engage qualified prospects
  • Generate meetings and pipeline opportunities for the sales team

Cold Calling & Appointment Setting

  • Make 30–40+ cold calls per day
  • Execute 60–100 outbound touchpoints per day
  • Communicate value clearly and confidently
  • Handle objections professionally
  • Qualify prospects based on business needs and fit
  • Book qualified meetings for Account Executives
  • Maintain consistent follow-up across active prospects

CRM & Pipeline Management

  • Maintain accurate CRM records using:
    • HubSpot
    • Salesforce
    • Zoho
    • Similar CRM platforms
  • Track outreach activity, prospect conversations, lead stages, and follow-ups
  • Keep pipeline data clean and current
  • Ensure accurate visibility into prospecting activity and outcomes
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene and follow-through

Outreach Optimization

  • A/B test email copy, messaging, subject lines, and sequences
  • Monitor:
    • Response rates
    • Meeting conversion rates
    • Outreach performance
    • Pipeline generated
  • Identify opportunities to improve targeting and messaging
  • Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance data

Must-Have Experience & Skills

  • 1–3+ years of experience in:
    • SDR or BDR roles
    • Outbound sales
    • Appointment setting
    • Lead generation
  • Hands-on experience with cold calling and outbound prospecting
  • Experience executing multi-channel sales outreach
  • Familiarity with tools such as:
    • Apollo
    • Outreach.io
    • Salesloft
    • LinkedIn Sales Navigator
    • ZoomInfo
  • Experience with HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, or similar CRM systems
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Comfortable handling high daily outreach volumes
  • Strong objection-handling and prospect communication skills
  • Highly organized with consistent follow-up discipline
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment during U.S. business hours

Nice to Have

  • B2B SaaS or professional services sales experience
  • Experience prospecting into SMB and mid-market companies
  • Familiarity with SPIN, MEDDIC, or Challenger Sales
  • Experience working against meeting, activity, or pipeline quotas
  • Experience optimizing outbound sequences and messaging

Tools & Platforms

LinkedIn Sales Navigator | Apollo | ZoomInfo | Outreach.io | Salesloft | HubSpot | Salesforce | Zoho | Google Workspace

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You’re confident picking up the phone and starting conversations
  • You enjoy outbound prospecting and creating opportunities from scratch
  • You’re resilient and comfortable handling rejection and objections
  • You communicate clearly and professionally
  • You thrive in KPI-driven sales environments
  • You’re disciplined about follow-ups and CRM organization
  • You understand that consistent activity drives pipeline
  • You’re motivated by measurable sales results

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day researching target accounts and building prospect lists, then move into dedicated cold-calling and outreach blocks.

Throughout the day, you’ll send personalized emails, engage prospects through LinkedIn, follow up across multiple touchpoints, qualify interested prospects, and book meetings for the sales team.

You’ll also update CRM activity and review outreach performance to improve future campaigns.

In short: you generate pipeline by consistently finding, engaging, and converting prospects into qualified sales opportunities.

Key Metrics for Success

  • 60–100 outbound touchpoints per day
  • 30–40+ cold calls per day
  • Qualified meetings booked
  • Outreach response rates
  • Meeting conversion rates
  • Pipeline and opportunities generated
  • Consistent prospecting activity
  • CRM accuracy and pipeline hygiene

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on pipeline and revenue growth
  • High ownership over outbound prospecting
  • Exposure to modern sales and lead-generation tools
  • Clear and measurable performance expectations
  • Opportunity to sharpen B2B prospecting and sales skills
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Growth opportunities into:
    • Senior SDR
    • Account Executive
    • Business Development
    • Sales Leadership

Interview Process

  1. Initial Phone Screen
  2. Spark Hire Video Interview
  3. Recruiter Interview
  4. Outreach Exercise / Practical Task
  5. Client Interview
  6. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you enjoy outbound sales, cold calling, prospecting, and building pipeline, and you’re motivated by turning outreach into qualified opportunities, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply now and help build a high-performing outbound sales pipeline.

raw.description:
(This role is US based remote and all candidates must be able to work in the US now and in the future without restriction)

What we believe

Technology is no longer just an enabler of business strategy. It is the business strategy. And with AI reshaping how companies operate, compete and grow — while rapidly accelerating the pace of change — the stakes have never been higher.

Our role

We’re focused on helping private equity investors and portfolio company leaders drive value creation through technology. In a world where investors deploy trillions annually into software and tech-enabled businesses, we're the team that makes sure the underlying technology actually delivers.

Our approach

The expert judgment of our experienced practitioners is complemented by proven frameworks, tech-enabled solutions, and objective data to help organizations navigate critical technology decisions across diligence, transformation, growth, cybersecurity, AI, and operational execution.

What we value

Everything we do is grounded in five core values: Service. Curiosity. Credibility. Commitment. Creativity.

If you're energized by solving complex technology challenges and helping others succeed in critical moments, you'llfit right in.

Job Role

    We’re building small, highly capable engineering pods (2–3 engineers) that own problems end-to-end and move quickly from idea to production. This role is for engineers who are comfortable operating across the full stack and using modern AI-enabled workflows to accelerate delivery.

    This role is part of our Tooling team, focused on rapidly building lightweight internal tools that improve how Crosslake teams work. These tools are typically narrow in scope and designed to be created, tested, and deployed quickly. The emphasis is on speed, usefulness, and iteration over long-term productization.

    You’ll be expected to design, build, and ship software with minimal handoffs—working across frontend, backend, and infrastructure as needed. This role prioritizes speed and iteration, with a focus on delivering immediate value.

    How we work

  • Small teams, high ownership, minimal handoffs
  • Fast, iterative delivery over heavy process
  • Pragmatic decision-making over over-engineering
  • Engineers are expected to operate across the stack, not within silos
  • Many tools are short-lived or heavily iterated—impact matters more than longevity

Key Responsibilities

  • 7+ years of software engineering experience
  • Strong full-stack capability (frontend, backend, and cloud infrastructure)
  • Comfortable stepping into an architectural role when needed
  • Experience deploying and operating applications in cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP)
  • Solid understanding of the full SDLC
  • Deep experience with (i.e., daily usage of) AI coding tools

Requirements

  • Design and build small, high-impact full-stack tools from concept to deployment
  • Own the full SDLC: design, development, testing, deployment, and iteration
  • Work within a small pod to deliver quickly with a high degree of autonomy
  • Rapidly prototype and validate solutions with internal stakeholders
  • Integrate with third-party tools, APIs, and internal systems
  • Make pragmatic technical decisions appropriate for fast-moving tools
  • Use AI tools to accelerate development, testing, and code quality
  • Continuously refine, replace, or retire tools based on usage and feedback

    • AI-Native Development

    • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted development tools beyond basic code generation
    • Ability to leverage AI across the workflow (e.g., prototyping, debugging, test generation, QA, code review, security analysis)
    • Experience combining AI with automation/orchestration to streamline workflows and reduce manual effort
    • Familiarity with modern AI-enabled development environments and practices

Preferred Experience

  • Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform)
  • CI/CD and modern DevOps practices
  • Experience with workflow automation/orchestration tools (e.g., n8n, Zapier, Temporal, Airflow)
  • Experience integrating SaaS tools and APIs (Slack, Notion, Jira, etc.)
  • Comfort building lightweight internal UIs (dashboards, admin panels, etc.)
  • Experience with one or more of the following languages: Python, TypeScript, Golang, Rust
  • Basic understanding of data engineering principles

What success looks like

  • You ramp quickly and start contributing within weeks
  • You identify inefficiencies and ship tools to address them
  • You deliver simple solutions that meaningfully improve team productivity
  • You avoid overbuilding and focus on practical outcomes
  • You effectively use AI tools to increase speed and output

raw.description:
About Stride
Stride helps independent workers access health, dental, and vision benefits. Stride is now part of Integrity, expanding the resources and capabilities available to the workers we serve.
Position Details
● Seasonal W-2 employment beginning October 12, 2026
● All Enrollment Operations Specialists are expected to remain through the December 31, 2026 CCA enrollment deadline. After December 31, the team will be reduced in phases based on enrollment volume and business needs, with individual assignments anticipated to end on January 15 or February 5, 2027.

● $23.00 per hour

  • 40 hours per week, Monday–Friday, 8:00am–4:00pm PST
    ● Non-exempt and overtime eligible; additional hours may be available or required during peak periods based on business needs
    The Role
    We are looking for detail-oriented professionals to join our Enrollment Operations team during Open Enrollment.
    This is a high-trust operational role responsible for accurately processing insurance enrollment activity and resolving issues that can directly affect a consumer's coverage. The work requires strong judgment, attention to detail, discretion, and the ability to follow established processes in a high-volume environment.
    Experience with ACA health insurance enrollment, Healthcare.gov, or state-based marketplaces such as Covered California is strongly preferred.
    Responsibilities
    ● Review and process consumer enrollment, termination, and cancellation requests
    ● Identify and resolve enrollment errors, discrepancies, and missing information
    ● Follow established processes for handling enrollment activity and sensitive consumer information
    ● Contact consumers when additional information or action is required
    ● Research issues and coordinate with internal teams when appropriate
    ● Escalate complex or high-risk issues with clear documentation
    ● Maintain accurate records of enrollment activity and communications in Zendesk or similar systems
    ● Identify recurring issues and communicate trends or process gaps to management
    ● Support the Enrollment Operations team during periods of high volume
    Qualifications
    When reviewing resumes, we'll look for experience that indicates:
    ● Experience managing detailed, process-driven work in which accuracy and timely execution were essential
    ● Experience identifying discrepancies, researching issues, and determining or coordinating the appropriate next step
    ● Experience following established processes and handling sensitive or confidential information
    ● Experience maintaining accurate records and documenting actions and communications in business systems
    ● Experience communicating directly with consumers or customers and coordinating with internal teams to resolve issues
    ● Experience working independently in a high-volume environment with changing priorities
    ● Experience using technology and digital tools to manage workflows, records, and communications, including learning new systems as needed
    Preferred Experience
    We'll prioritize candidates with resumes that indicate:
    ● Experience in health insurance operations, broker services, member support, or enrollment processing
    ● Experience with ACA enrollment, including eligibility, plan selection, or coverage changes
    ● Experience using Healthcare.gov or state-based marketplaces such as Covered California
    ● Experience using Zendesk or a similar CRM or support platform
    ● Experience working in a high-volume Open Enrollment environment
    ● Experience working effectively in a fully remote environment
    ● Experience in a startup, small business, or similarly fast-paced environment where you were expected to take ownership and wear multiple hats
    What We'll Assess During the Interview
    During the interview process, we'll assess:
    ● Critical thinking and problem-solving - the ability to assess a situation, identify relevant information, and determine the appropriate next step
    ● Attention to detail - the ability to maintain accuracy under pressure
    ● Judgment, discretion, and accountability when handling sensitive information and enrollment activity
    ● Process discipline and independence - the ability to work with limited guidance while following established processes precisely
    ● Written and verbal communication - the ability to document actions clearly and communicate effectively with consumers and internal teams
    ● Comfort in a high-volume environment with changing priorities
    ● Technical learning agility - the ability to learn and navigate new systems quickly
    ● Ownership and adaptability - the willingness to take responsibility for work and respond effectively to new or unfamiliar tasks
    What Success Looks Like
    You process enrollment work accurately, consistently, and on time. You take ownership of your work, recognize when something is wrong, document your actions clearly, and escalate issues appropriately.
    Accuracy is critical in this role. Small enrollment errors can have significant consequences for consumers, and we expect every team member to treat that responsibility seriously.

About Integrity

Integrity is one of the nation’s leading independent distributors of life, health and wealth insurance products. With a strong insurtech focus, we embrace a broad and innovative approach to serving agents and clients alike. Integrity is driven by a singular purpose: to help people protect their life, health and wealth so they can prepare for the good days ahead.

Integrity offers you the opportunity to start a career in a family-like environment that is rewarding and cutting edge. Why? Because we put our people first! At Integrity, you can start a new career path at company you’ll love, and we’ll love you back. We’re proud of the work we do and the culture we’ve built, where we celebrate your hard work and support you daily. Joining us means being part of a hyper-growth company with tons of professional opportunities for you to accelerate your career. Integrity offers our people a competitive compensation package, including benefits that make work more fun and give you and your family peace of mind.

Headquartered in Dallas, Texas, Integrity is committed to meeting Americans wherever they are — in person, over the phone or online. Integrity’s employees support hundreds of thousands of independent agents who serve the needs of millions of clients nationwide. For more information, visit Integrity.com.

Integrity, LLC is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, Integrity, LLC will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

Job Title:

Customer Acquisition Representative

Job Description

The Customer Acquisition Representative is responsible for demonstrating the value and benefits of our client’s products or services through customer engagement, with a primary focus on selling and/or renewing contracts. This role is responsible for effectively articulating the value of products or services to customers. This position ensures performance metrics are achieved by providing adequate coaching, motivation and accountability. (Military veterans are encouraged to apply.)

  • A NEW CAREER POWERED BY YOU

    Are you looking for a “work from home” career change with a forward-thinking global organizationthat nurtures a true people-first, inclusiveculture and a genuine sense of belonging? Would you like to join a Fortune 500 company that earns “World’s Best Workplaces,” “Best Company Culture,” and “Best Companies for Career Growth”awards every year? Then a remote Team Leader position at Concentrix is the right place for you!

    As a remote Customer Acquisition,you’ll join an organically diverse team from around the globe where all members contribute to and support each other’s success and wellbeing, proudly united as “game-changers.” Together, we serve as the intelligent transformation partner for the world’s best-known brands, delivering exceptional customer experiences with tech-powered innovation.

    CAREER GROWTH AND PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT

    This is a great “work from home” opportunity that will allow you toreimagine an all-new career journey and develop “friends for life” at the same time.We’ll give you all the training, technologies, and ongoingsupportyou’ll need to succeed. Plus, at Concentrix, there’s real career (and personal) growth potential. In fact, about 80% of our managers and leaders have been promoted from within!That’s why we offer a range of no-cost learning and leadership development programs designed to set you on your way to the kind of career you’vealways envisioned.

    WHAT YOU WILL DO IN THIS ROLE

    Asa Customer Acquisition Representativeworking from home, you will:

    • Conduct outbound outreach to prospective business and fleet customers using leads provided through approved lead-generation and marketing channels.

    • Engage business owners, fleet managers, procurement contacts, and other potential decision-makers to understand their vehicle and fleet needs.

    • Conduct effective discovery conversations to identify customer needs, purchasing timelines, fleet requirements, and potential sales opportunities.

    • Qualify prospects using agreed-upon client and Concentrix qualification criteria.

    • Educate prospective customers at a high level regarding relevant client commercial/fleet vehicle solutions and available next steps.

    • Build rapport and establish credibility with prospective B2B customers.

    • Identify and develop sales-qualified leads (SQLs) for handoff to the appropriate dealership or sales resource.

    • Ensure qualified opportunities are transferred with accurate and complete information to support effective sales follow-up.

    • Conduct appropriate follow-up and lead-nurturing activities for prospects who are not immediately ready for sales engagement.

    • Maintain accurate documentation of customer interactions, qualification information, disposition, follow-up activities, and outcomes within designated CRM and client systems.

    • Manage assigned leads and opportunities in accordance with established service levels, processes, and productivity expectations.

    • Partner with client, Concentrix, marketing, and other program stakeholders as appropriate to support lead quality and continuous process improvement.

    • Participate in required training, coaching, calibration, and certification activities.

    • Provide feedback regarding lead quality, customer responses, common objections, market trends, and opportunities to improve the sales process.

    • Meet established quality, productivity, conversion, and performance expectations as defined for the program.

    • Maintain compliance with Concentrix and client policies, procedures, confidentiality requirements, and applicable data security standards.

    • Deliverexpertcustomer experiences…with a smile.

    YOUR QUALIFICATIONS

    Your skills, integrity, and genuine compassion will deliver value and success with every customer interaction. Other qualifications for our Customer Acquisition (Remote)role include:

    • 18 Years of age or older with a completed High School Diploma or GED required

    • 2+ years of experience working in a customer service or sales capacity

    • Prior success in achievement of personal and team sales quota/goals

    • Experience in high-volume calling

    • Experience learning new technology and data

    • Problem solving skills

    • Excellent knowledge of MS Office programs

    • Experience working with Salesforce.com or similar CRM

    • Experience or willingness to work from home

    • Previous experience in business development, inside sales, outbound sales, lead generation, account development, or a related customer-facing sales role.

    • Experience conducting outbound calls and engaging prospective business customers.

    • B2B sales or business development experience preferred.

    • Experience identifying customer needs through discovery and qualifying potential sales opportunities.

    • Ability to communicate effectively with business owners, managers, procurement contacts, and other decision-makers.

    • Strong questioning, active-listening, relationship-building, and objection-handling skills.

    • Ability to communicate value and generate customer interest without relying solely on scripted interactions.

    • Experience working with CRM, lead-management, or sales-tracking systems.

    • Strong organizational and follow-up skills with the ability to manage multiple leads and activities simultaneously.

    • Ability to accurately document customer interactions and maintain detailed CRM records.

    • Comfortable working within established sales goals, KPIs, quality standards, and productivity expectations.

    • Ability to learn new products, systems, processes, and industry terminology quickly.

    • Strong collaboration skills and ability to operate effectively in a dynamic environment where processes may continue to evolve.

    • Proficiency in fast-paced multitasking.

    • Eagerness to learn new technologies.

    • Must reside in the United States and have a valid U.S. address for residence.

    WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU

    One of our company’s Culture Beliefs says, “We champion our people.” That’s why we invest in our game-changers, our infrastructure, and our capabilities to ensure long-term success for both our teams and our clients. And we’ll invest in YOU to aid in your career path and in your personal development. Benefits available to eligible U.S. employees in this role include:

    • The OTE salary range for this position is $20.94- $20.94/hr.(pay rate will not be below the applicable minimum wage), Actual salaries will vary based on work location, qualifications, skills, education, experience, and competencies. Benefits available to eligible employees in this role include medical, dental, and vision insurance, a comprehensive employee assistance program (EAP), a 401(k)-retirement plan, paid time off, and holidays.

    • Paid training and lucrative employee referral program.

    • DailyPay enrollment option to access pay "early," when you want it.

    • Health and wellness programs with trained partners to help promote a healthy you.

    • Mentorship programs that support your rewarding career journey.

    • Work-from-home convenience with company-supplied technologies.

    • Programs and events that support inclusion and belonging, as well as global citizenship, sustainability, and community support.

    • Company networking opportunities with organized groups in the following topics: Network of Women, Black Professionals, LGBTQ+ Pride, Ability (disabilities), Dynamic (neurodiversity), Women in Tech, OneEarth Champions, Wise Owls (experienced), and more.

Job Details

This role is in support of Cencora's patient and provider support and pharma
commercialization services in Canada marketed through our Innomar Strategies business.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide support to patients and health care providers by offering information on the Patient Support services, specific diseases, and therapies based on manufacturer provided materials and product monograph;

  • Assist patients and caregivers in conducting assessments related to Patient Support services;

  • Act as a liaison between patients, families and health care providers related to medication access.

  • Address general inquiries regarding program services, disease states, or product related queries based on provided materials;

  • Offer continuous support on disease states or product-related questions to ensure patient adherence;

  • Document patient information and interactions within the electronic patient record;

  • Conduct ongoing file review and updates to reflect patient journey;

  • Collaborate with the reimbursement specialist and the physician to secure funding for their patient’s therapies and explore alternative funding options;

  • Ensure patient services are coordinated and tracked, according to KPI’s, resulting in expedited access to therapy;

  • Participate in specialized training sessions for specific therapies provided by the pharmaceutical team;

  • Attend pharmaceutical meetings, patient meetings, conferences, and work with patient associations and advocacy groups as needed ;

  • Coordinate with health care providers, pharmacies and infusion/injection clinics for treatment logistics and issue resolution;

  • Maintain clear communication with the manager, team and the client regarding the management of patient cases;

  • Assist in the training process of new Nurse Case Managers and provide feedback on protocols, databases, processes and inter-departmental processes;

  • Report Adverse Events / Severe Adverse Events following program procedures;

  • The Nurse Case Manager will also be assigned other duties and tasks as required from time to time. May be required to be on standby/ on call as part of this role.

Education:

  • A Diploma in health care or a related field, with a preference for Bachelor’s degree
  • Licensed Nurse (RN or RPN/LPN) with active registration from the College of Nurses in the province of employment is required.

Why MSI? We thrive on solving challenges.

As a leading MGA, MSI combines deep underwriting expertise with insurer risk capacity to create specialized insurance solutions that empower distribution partners to meet customers’ unique needs.

We have a passion for crafting solutions for the important risks facing individuals and businesses. We offer an expanding suite of products – from fully-digital embedded renters coverage to high-value homeowners insurance to sophisticated commercial coverages, such as cyber liability and habitational property – delivered through agents, brokers, wholesalers and other brand partners.

Our partners and customers count on us to deliver exceptional service through a dedicated team that makes rapid resolutions a priority. We simplify the insurance experience through our advanced technology platform that supports every phase of the policy lifecycle. Bring on your challenges and let us show you how we build insurance better.

The Claims Examiner II is considered an expert in managing insurance claims for our policyholders, handling claims with a higher level of complexity. The Claims Examiner II must have technical knowledge in insurance claims handling and the skills needed to provide superior service for our customers. The ability to develop relationships and effectively communicate with a diverse range of clients, carriers and colleagues is a key success factor in this role. Strategic vision coupled with tactical execution to achieve results in accordance with goals and objectives is also critical to the overall success of this position.

PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:
• Analyzes insurance policies and other documents to determine insurance coverage.
• Investigates and analyzes claim information to determine extent of liability.
• Handles claims 1st Party Property Claims of a high level of complexity.
• Assist in suits, mediations and arbitrations. Works with Counsel in the defense of litigation.
• Sets timely, adequate reserves in compliance with the company’s reserving philosophy.
• Engages experts to assist in the evaluation of the claim.
• Monitors vendor performance and controls expense costs.
• Evaluates, negotiates and determines settlement values.
• Communicates with all interested parties throughout the life of the claim. Proactively discusses coverage decisions, the need for additional information, and settlement amounts with interested parties.
• Handles all claims in accordance with Best Practices.
• Responsible for monitoring and completing assigned claims inventory.
• Acquire and maintain a state adjuster’s license and meet state continuing education requirements.
• Provides Best-In-Class customer service for insureds and agents.

• Updates and maintains the claim file.

  • Identifies opportunities for subrogation and ensures recovery interests are protected.
    • Identifies fraud indicators and refers files to SIU for further investigation.
    • Participates in claims audits, internal and external.
    • Provides oversight of TPAs

    EDUCATION & EXPERIENCE:
    High School/GED
    5-9 years' experience in claims
    Must have Property & Casualty Insurance License

raw.description:
Project Delivery and Technical Project Solutions Professionals

About Us

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunization rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response, and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare. Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Today we’ve worked in over 17 countries helping deliver health, aid, and finance to >3M people. Our goal is to transform the way the world fights poverty, ensuring that every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

Department Overview

Primary Function: The Delivery team at Simprints is responsible for the successful implementation of our biometric solutions in the field. They work closely with partners and internal teams to ensure projects are executed smoothly, meeting both technical and operational requirements to deliver maximum impact.

Key Goals:

  • Ensure successful implementation and execution of biometric projects in the field.
  • Collaborate with partners and internal teams to meet project goals and timelines.
  • Continuously improve delivery processes to maximize efficiency and impact.

Join Our Delivery Talent Pool at Simprints

Are you passionate about delivering technology-driven projects that create real-world impact? At Simprints, we’re always looking for talented professionals to join our mission of transforming global development through cutting-edge technology. Whether you specialize in project delivery, technical project management, or implementation support, we want to hear from you!

What We Do in Delivery

Our Delivery team ensures that Simprints' solutions are successfully implemented in diverse global settings. We work closely with partners to design, deploy, and scale biometric and digital identity projects, ensuring they deliver meaningful impact. From managing complex field deployments to providing technical solutions that solve real-world challenges, our team is at the forefront of making our technology work in the field.

Who We’re Looking For

We know that these are uncertain times for many professionals in the international development space, and we truly appreciate your interest in joining Simprints.

While we may not have an immediate role that aligns with your experience, we are always looking to connect with talented individuals who are passionate about using technology for social impact. By submitting your CV, you allow us to keep your details on file, and should a relevant opportunity arise, we will reach out to explore a potential fit. Thank you for considering Simprints, we appreciate the important work you do, and we hope to stay in touch.

We welcome professionals at all levels with experience in:
✔ Project & Program Management in Global Development
✔ Technical Project Management & Solutions Design
✔ Field Operations & Implementation Support

✔ Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

Experience in international development, social enterprises, or working with NGOs is a huge plus! If you're excited about delivering technology solutions that drive global change, submit your CV today—we’d love to explore how you can be part of the Simprints journey. 🚀

Requirements

What You Could Work On

  • Project Delivery & Implementation: Oversee end-to-end project execution, from initial planning to deployment and impact measurement.
  • Technical Project Solutions: Work with partners to design and configure Simprints' technology to meet specific project needs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineers, product teams, and external stakeholders to align technology with real-world use cases.
  • Training & Capacity Building: Equip partners and field teams with the knowledge and tools to successfully use Simprints' technology.
  • Problem-Solving in Challenging Environments: Navigate logistical, technical, and operational challenges to ensure seamless project execution.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognized Great Place to Work, part of the Flexa Top 100 Most Flexible Companies and a 2022 Best Workplace for Women.

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

4. Ultimate work-life balance.

    1. We offer a 4-day workweek, meaning everybody has the option to have Fridays off.
    2. We also offer unlimited annual leave, which allows you to prioritize your well-being

As long as you're driving results and fostering teamwork, we encourage you to strike that perfect balance between your professional and personal life. Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.

5. Professional development. We promote continual learning and put our money where our mouth is with development plans and access to global experts through the GLG network

We also have a generous professional development budget for each colleague – “Eduprints”. Is there some training you’d like, or maybe you could benefit from professional coaching? Simply provide a business case that shares your aspirations and the resources you need, and we'll do our best to support you.

We care about both your development in Simprints and your holistic long-term career goals. Simprints Alumni have gone on to work for Google, USAID, Gavi the vaccine alliance, Save the Children, and other top players.

raw.description:
Job Title:

Lead Mobile Developer - Bilingual

Job Description

We're Concentrix. The intelligent transformation partner. Solution-focused. Tech-powered. Intelligence-fueled.

The global technology and services leader that powers the world’s best brands, today and into the future. We’re solution-focused, tech-powered, intelligence-fueled. With unique data and insights, deep industry expertise, and advanced technology solutions, we’re the intelligent transformation partner that powers a world that works, helping companies become refreshingly simple to work, interact, and transact with. We shape new game-changing careers in over 70 countries, attracting the best talent.

The Concentrix Technical Products and Services team is the driving force behind Concentrix’s transformation, data, and technology services. We integrate world-class digital engineering, creativity, and a deep understanding of human behavior to find and unlock value through tech-powered and intelligence-fueled experiences. We combine human-centered design, powerful data, and strong tech to accelerate transformation at scale. You will be surrounded by the best in the world providing market leading technology and insights to modernize and simplify the customer experience. Within our professional services team, you will deliver strategic consulting, design, advisory services, market research, and contact center analytics that deliver insights to improve outcomes and value for our clients. Hence achieving our vision.

Our game-changers around the world have devoted their careers to ensuring every relationship is exceptional. And we’re proud to be recognized with awards such as "World's Best Workplaces," “Best Companies for Career Growth,” and “Best Company Culture,” year after year.

Join us and be part of this journey towards greater opportunities and brighter futures.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Lead Mobile Developer with 12+ years of overall IT experience, including 5+ years in mobile application development and 4+ years of hands-on experience with React Native. The ideal candidate is a technical leader capable of architecting and delivering high-quality mobile experiences across multiple restaurant brands. You will be responsible for defining and implementing scalable engineering practices, building reusable components, and driving a consistent mobile technology strategy across both iOS and Android platforms. In this role, you will work closely with product, UX, QA, backend, and business stakeholders to translate brand and customer needs into reliable, performant, and scalable mobile applications.

Key Responsibilities

  • Architecture and Development: Lead the design and hands-on delivery of mobile applications using React Native. Ensure all solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with enterprise goals.

  • Multi-Brand Strategy: Architect mobile experiences for multiple restaurant brands. Balance shared capabilities with the specific requirements of each brand to ensure a tailored customer experience.

  • Engineering Excellence: Define and implement coding standards, architecture patterns, and development best practices to improve team efficiency and technical governance.

  • Reusable Components: Drive the development and adoption of reusable modules and shared frameworks to reduce redundancy and accelerate feature delivery across the mobile portfolio.

  • Technical Leadership: Provide hands-on contribution through development, code reviews, and debugging. Mentor engineers and guide the technical direction of the team.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with product managers, designers, QA, and backend teams in an agile environment to ensure smooth integration, testing, and release planning.

  • Performance and Quality: Monitor and improve application performance, stability, and reliability. Address platform-specific challenges and ensure operational excellence for production environments.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience: 12+ years of overall software engineering experience, with at least 5+ years in mobile development.

  • Technical Skills: 4+ years of hands-on experience with React Native.

  • Leadership: Proven experience as a hands-on technical leader, with the ability to manage architecture decisions, enforce standards, and mentor team members.

  • Scalability: Strong understanding of modular architecture, reusable design patterns, and shared component strategies.

  • Platforms: Demonstrated success delivering and supporting mobile products across both iOS and Android.

  • Communication: Excellent communication skills in both English and Spanish to support diverse stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

Location:

MEX Work-at-Home

Language Requirements:

Time Type:

Full time

Project Delivery and Technical Project Solutions Professionals

About Us

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunization rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response, and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare. Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Today we’ve worked in over 17 countries helping deliver health, aid, and finance to >3M people. Our goal is to transform the way the world fights poverty, ensuring that every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

Department Overview

Primary Function: The Delivery team at Simprints is responsible for the successful implementation of our biometric solutions in the field. They work closely with partners and internal teams to ensure projects are executed smoothly, meeting both technical and operational requirements to deliver maximum impact.

Key Goals:

  • Ensure successful implementation and execution of biometric projects in the field.
  • Collaborate with partners and internal teams to meet project goals and timelines.
  • Continuously improve delivery processes to maximize efficiency and impact.

Join Our Delivery Talent Pool at Simprints

Are you passionate about delivering technology-driven projects that create real-world impact? At Simprints, we’re always looking for talented professionals to join our mission of transforming global development through cutting-edge technology. Whether you specialize in project delivery, technical project management, or implementation support, we want to hear from you!

What We Do in Delivery

Our Delivery team ensures that Simprints' solutions are successfully implemented in diverse global settings. We work closely with partners to design, deploy, and scale biometric and digital identity projects, ensuring they deliver meaningful impact. From managing complex field deployments to providing technical solutions that solve real-world challenges, our team is at the forefront of making our technology work in the field.

Who We’re Looking For

We know that these are uncertain times for many professionals in the international development space, and we truly appreciate your interest in joining Simprints.

While we may not have an immediate role that aligns with your experience, we are always looking to connect with talented individuals who are passionate about using technology for social impact. By submitting your CV, you allow us to keep your details on file, and should a relevant opportunity arise, we will reach out to explore a potential fit. Thank you for considering Simprints, we appreciate the important work you do, and we hope to stay in touch.

We welcome professionals at all levels with experience in:
✔ Project & Program Management in Global Development
✔ Technical Project Management & Solutions Design
✔ Field Operations & Implementation Support

✔ Stakeholder & Partner Coordination

Experience in international development, social enterprises, or working with NGOs is a huge plus! If you're excited about delivering technology solutions that drive global change, submit your CV today—we’d love to explore how you can be part of the Simprints journey. 🚀

Requirements

What You Could Work On

  • Project Delivery & Implementation: Oversee end-to-end project execution, from initial planning to deployment and impact measurement.
  • Technical Project Solutions: Work with partners to design and configure Simprints' technology to meet specific project needs.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with engineers, product teams, and external stakeholders to align technology with real-world use cases.
  • Training & Capacity Building: Equip partners and field teams with the knowledge and tools to successfully use Simprints' technology.
  • Problem-Solving in Challenging Environments: Navigate logistical, technical, and operational challenges to ensure seamless project execution.

Benefits

5 Reasons to Join Simprints

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

1. Genuine Impact. Work directly with our partners and users to deliver technology that has the potential to impact millions of lives across the globe. At Simprints, you’ll be part of a team that is passionate about driving real change.

2. An incredible, diverse team. Our work is at the intersection of technology and global development, and we’ve managed to build an amazing team drawn from all over the world. But don’t take our word for it—we’re an externally recognized Great Place to Work, part of the Flexa Top 100 Most Flexible Companies and a 2022 Best Workplace for Women.

3. Mutual Flex. We champion a work culture where autonomy and trust are paramount, steering clear of mere face-time metrics. Whether it's managing life's essentials like healthcare appointments or adapting work hours to match your peak productivity times, we've got you covered. In return, we count on your reciprocal flexibility when mission-critical moments arise, like stepping up for a crucial client discussion on a Friday or tackling unexpected technical glitches beyond regular hours.

4. Ultimate work-life balance.

    1. We offer a 4-day workweek, meaning everybody has the option to have Fridays off.
    2. We also offer unlimited annual leave, which allows you to prioritize your well-being

As long as you're driving results and fostering teamwork, we encourage you to strike that perfect balance between your professional and personal life. Our commitment to this model's success is solidified through semi-annual productivity assessments with our board, ensuring that our high standards of performance are consistently met.

5. Professional development. We promote continual learning and put our money where our mouth is with development plans and access to global experts through the GLG network

We also have a generous professional development budget for each colleague – “Eduprints”. Is there some training you’d like, or maybe you could benefit from professional coaching? Simply provide a business case that shares your aspirations and the resources you need, and we'll do our best to support you.

We care about both your development in Simprints and your holistic long-term career goals. Simprints Alumni have gone on to work for Google, USAID, Gavi the vaccine alliance, Save the Children, and other top players.

raw.description:
Job Title: Senior Software Engineer
Company: Cooperative Technologies
Location: US
Employment Type : Full-time

About Cooperative Technologies

Cooperative Technologies (“CT”) is the only company in the US that provides ceding carrier data for annuity and life insurance exchanges, making the platform the de facto standard for replacement processing. The market for US annuity sales is projected to double to ~$900B by 2030 with CT at the center of that growth.

CT is at an inflection point and looking for future leaders to champion the next phase of growth for the organizations. The company is now searching for a senior software engineer who can own an AI roadmap, mentor junior resources, and write the code to ship its product. Working in an entrepreneurial fully remote environment, the hired candidate will have high visibility and autonomy.

What You'll Actually Do

  • Design, build, and ship product enhancements to the 1035YellowPages platform in VB.NET/C#/.NET, including database objects, ASP.NET Web Forms, and WCF web services.
  • Debug, triage, and resolve defects and performance issues across the full stack
  • Build and maintain the technical integration that moves data between CT and its clients.
  • Coordinate new client onboarding and serve as the direct technical contact for existing web site and web service clients, including support escalations.
  • Generating 30%+ of your code output using AI-assisted development tools and using them thoughtfully to accelerate delivery without sacrificing quality.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience, with significant time as the senior or sole engineer accountable for a production system.
  • Programming Proficiency: C#, .NET Framework / .NET, VB.NET, JavaScript, SQL, VB 6, Visual C++ (Nice-to-have)
  • Windows Developmentand Database Technologies: Windows Forms (WinForms), ASP.NET Web Forms, WCF Web Services, Windows Services. HTML, CSS, Database Technologies, Microsoft SQL Server, T-SQL
  • Demonstrated ability to work directly with enterprise clients on technical issues, integration work, and support escalations.
  • Track record shipping and supporting production software in a small-team environment where you owned the outcome end to end, not a slice of a larger platform team.
  • Comfort operating in an established codebase with legacy components, including sole responsibility for systems you did not write.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Azure DevOps, REST APIs, or ASP.NET MVC.
  • Familiarity with legacy migration projects — specifically managing a system through end-of-life.
  • Prior use of FogBugz or similar issue-tracking tools

What Success Looks Like — First 90 Days

  • At least one enhancement or defect fix shipped to production independently.
  • Working command of the 1035YellowPages codebase and data model sufficient to scope, estimate, and deliver without supervision.
  • Knowledge transfer from the retiring technical team captured in writing, so the critical paths through the system no longer live in one person's head.

Who You'll Work With

You report directly to CT's executive leadership team. Product direction comes from CT's executive leadership and the Director of Business Development & Operations, who translate market and client requirements into priorities. This is a senior individual contributor role with high autonomy and high impact.

On any given day you might be writing code in the morning, resolving a client integration issue at noon, and sitting with the retiring technical team in the afternoon to pull one more system out of their heads and into yours. CT's team is small and this role has real influence over how the product gets built.

What We Offer

  • Mentorship from a retiring technical team handing over the reins to a new generation.
  • Ownership of the training and development plan for a junior resource, including shaping how they ramp, what they learn, and how they progress.
  • A direct line from your code to the customer, with visibility into how the business makes money.
  • Exposure to the Solen Software Group portfolio company network and operating model.

Recruitment Disclaimer

Solen Software Group will never request payment, banking information, or other sensitive personal or financial details during any stage of the recruitment process. All official communication will come from a verified @solensoftwaregroup.com email address. Any outreach outside these standards should be disregarded and reported through our official channels.

We thank all applicants for their interest in joining Solen Software Group. Only candidates selected for an interview will be contacted.

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

  • Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.

  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution

  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
