raw.description:
Intuition Machines uses AI/ML to build enterprise security products. We apply our research to systems that serve hundreds of millions of people, with a team distributed around the world. You are probably familiar with our best-known product, the hCaptcha security suite. Our approach is simple: low overhead, small teams, and rapid iteration.

As a Senior ML Ops Engineer, you will help shape and expand the pipelines that power our products and research efforts. You’ll work across teams to design, maintain, and improve high-performance data pipelines, ensuring that data is accessible, reliable, and scalable to meet the needs of our users and internal stakeholders.

Using AI: Coding agents are indisputably useful tools. We provide access to the top 3 models, and were early adopters of evals-first development flows. Familiarity with coding using agents is part of all interviews. However, reliability and correctness are critical for us. You will need to read and understand every line of code with your name on it, and it will be reviewed by both people and machines.

What will you do:

  • Maintain, extend, and improve existing data/ML workflows, and implement new ones to handle high-velocity data.
  • Provide interfaces and systems that enable ML engineers and researchers to build datasets on demand.
  • Influence data storage and processing strategies.
  • Collaborate with the ML team, as well as frontend and backend teams, to build out our data platform.
  • Reduce time-to-deployment for dashboards and ML models.
  • Establish best practices and develop pipelines and software that enable ML engineers and researchers to efficiently build and use datasets.
  • Work with large datasets under performance constraints comparable to those at the largest companies.
  • Iterate quickly, with a focus on shipping early and often, ensuring that new products or features can be deployed to millions of users.

What we are looking for:

  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in a data role involving designing and building data stores, feature engineering, and building reliable data pipelines that handle high loads.
  • At least 2 years of professional software development experience in a role other than data engineering.
  • Proficiency in Python and experience working with Kafka infrastructure and distributed data systems.
  • Deep understanding of SQL and NoSQL databases (preferably Clickhouse).
  • Familiarity with public cloud providers (AWS or Azure).
  • Experience with CI/CD and orchestration platforms: Kubernetes, containerization, and microservice design.
  • Proven ability to make independent decisions regarding data processing strategy and architecture.
  • Thoughtful, self-directed individual who is able to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience collaborating across ML, backend, and frontend teams.
  • Understanding of machine learning fundamentals, including model training, inference, and frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.

What we offer:

  • Fully remote position with flexible working hours.
  • An inspiring team of colleagues spread all over the world.
  • Pleasant, modern development and deployment workflows: ship early, ship often.
  • High impact: lots of users, happy customers, high growth, and cutting-edge R&D.
  • Flat organization, direct interaction with customer teams.

We celebrate equality of opportunity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. Join us as we transform cybersecurity, user privacy, and machine learning online!

Please note that all positions require pre-employment screening, including third-party verification of work history, education, and identity, as well as a final in-person interview and identity verification step, which will be conducted in your country of residence.

CET is looking for a Waste Reduction Consultant I to join our mission-driven team.

If you have experience in waste reduction, recycling, reuse, food recovery, or composting—and want to help businesses make practical sustainability improvements—we’d love to hear from you!

This full-time, remote, field-based role is for someone located in or near Worcester, Boston, or within a 30-mile radius. You will help businesses reduce waste and improve operations by starting or strengthening recycling, reuse, food recovery, and composting programs. The role requires travel up to four days per week throughout the New England service area, with possible overnight travel.

Candidates must reside in the assigned territory and be able to travel within it up to 80% of the time to support customer and program needs. If you do not live in or near the geographic location specified above, we will not be able to consider your application.

Essential Job Functions 

In this position, you will: 

  • Conduct assessments of customer location(s) virtually and/or in person, including by field canvassing
  • Develop customized customer recommendations and present to customers persuasively
  • Regularly consult with and assist a portfolio of customers in implementing recommendations
  • Utilize different behavior change strategies to achieve a high rate of success in helping customers complete implementation
  • Build and maintain relationships with customers, industry partners, and relevant contacts throughout the waste diversion marketplace.
  • Deliver virtual and in-person presentations at workshops and conferences as needed.
  • Track and record project information and data in Salesforce.
  • Maintain knowledge of technologies, marketplace conditions, and strategies that may help customers improve facility waste diversion programs.
  • Calculate the tonnage of waste diversion and related cost savings as applicable.
  • Provide input and feedback on technical content for resources.
  • Network to create new opportunities and generate leads to secure potential customers, at times through cold calling.

The Skills You Bring and Requirements:

  • Minimum 2-3 years of waste diversion experience, including 1-3 years of commercial experience.
  • Experience with selling services preferred, with the ability to close on projects.
  • Experience in education, educational materials, or educational services preferred.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, with the ability to connect with diverse audiences.
  • Ability to speak a second language preferred (Spanish, Portuguese, or Mandarin is most helpful).
  • Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple programs and deliverables.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Ability to track and report results.
  • Work style should be flexible, reliable, and self-directed.

  • Must be able to pass a drug test and background check before the hire date.

Compensation and Benefits:

Your benefits start on day one: Health, wellness, and paid time off benefits begin on your very first day with us, so you're supported from the start.

CET is committed to transparent, equitable compensation. The posted range reflects available pay at posting; individual compensation is based on factors including qualifications, skills, and experience.

CET offers day-one health, wellness, and paid time off benefits, including generous PTO; paid and floating holidays; medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance; flexible spending accounts; supplemental coverage options; pet insurance; an employer-paid Employee Assistance Program; mindfulness and stress reduction offerings; and a retirement plan with a 3% company match.

Equally important, the CET team is mission-driven, kind, supportive, and collaborative. We care about the planet and about one another.

This is a full-time, remote position. CET will provide you with a laptop and other office technology. CET also provides a monthly $85 stipend for home internet and/or phone expenses.

CET is celebrating 50 years as a mission-based nonprofit helping people and businesses save energy, reduce waste, and implement sustainable solutions. The need to tackle climate change and rapidly decarbonize our economy makes our work more urgent than ever!

Vice President, Marketing Intelligence & Strategy

Are you excited by the opportunity to turn audience intelligence, competitive signals, and performance data into strategies that shape what we build, where we invest, and how we engage healthcare professionals and institutions worldwide?

Do you want to build a new marketing intelligence and strategy function from the ground up—defining how data, insights, and content come together to drive smarter decisions and measurable impact across Global Health Marketing?

About our Team:

Elsevier Health applies innovation, facilitates insights, and helps drive more informed decision-making for our customers across global health. We support health providers by providing accessible, trusted evidence-based information; prepare more medical and nursing students with effective tools and resources; provide insights that help clinicians improve patient outcomes; and support a more personalized and localized healthcare experience. All for the benefit of every patient.

About the role:

The VP, Marketing Intelligence & Strategy will own the data-to-strategy-to-content pipeline: the function that translates audience intelligence, competitive signals, and performance data into actionable decisions about what to build, where to invest, how to position, and what to say. This new introduction will move marketing to data-driven, insight-driven programs with a systematic translation of market signals into content strategy and investment decisions. This is a new function — which means you'll define what it becomes. You'll be the center of how Global Health Marketing plans and invests: translating data into strategy, audience intelligence into content, and market signals into decisions. It's a role that sits at the intersection of analytics, strategy, and marketing leadership.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the Marketing Intelligence & Strategy function — the organization’s center for market insight, content strategy, and investment intelligence. Data will impact strategic integrated marketing plans and the content created – building plans centered around driving influence across the buying journey.
  • Create annual Global Health Marketing plans in partnership with Product Marketing and Demand & Growth team (who will own distribution of content at scale across channels).
  • Own the unified attribution model: define how marketing investment translates to pipeline, retention, and revenue, in close partnership the Demand & Growth team, Product Marketing, and Finance.
  • Synthesize and leverage audience intelligence: inclusive of clinician behavior, student learning patterns, institutional buying journeys, etc. – and competitive positioning across Clinical Solutions and Education markets.
  • Set content strategy direction — the strategic framework that determines what content is created, for whom, and at what stage of the buying journey.
  • Develop competitive intelligence and market mapping; translate signals from the market into positioning and investment recommendations.
  • Develop an automation roadmap that accelerates content operations without sacrificing quality.
  • Present strategic recommendations to CMO and senior leadership; influence roadmap, budget, and org decisions with evidence.

Requirements:

  • 12+ years of marketing experience with a demonstrable track record of using data & insight to drive strategy — not just measure it.
  • Deep expertise in marketing analytics, attribution, and measurement — you can build measurement models, challenge a methodology, and translate results into business outcomes.
  • Strong content strategy instincts: you understand how insight should flow into content, and how content should serve the buying journey at every stage.
  • Experience building cross-functional intelligence functions — working with product, sales, finance, and external research partners.
  • Exceptional synthesis and communication skills; able to distil complex market signals into clear strategic recommendations.
  • Experience with AI marketing tools, personalization platforms, and the emerging landscape of autonomous content operations.
  • People leadership experience: you have built and led high-performing analytical and strategic marketing teams.
  • Prior experience in a healthcare/health tech — understanding healthcare professional behaviour and institutional buying dynamics.
  • Experience working with marketing programs that span both B2B and B2C; experience creating multi-faceted programs that can speak to both an end user and an institutional buyer.
  • Experience with advanced marketing analytics platforms (Salesforce Einstein, Adobe Analytics, Looker, Tableau, or equivalent).
  • Background in market research or audience intelligence at a research-intensive organization.
  • Familiarity with how AI is reshaping content creation, personalization, and marketing operations — and how to build governance around it.

Work in a way that works for you

We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long-term goals.

Working flexible hours - flexing the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive

About the business:

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. Building on our publishing heritage, we combine quality information and vast data sets with analytics to support visionary science and research, health education and interactive learning, as well as exceptional healthcare and clinical practice. What you do every day will help advance science and healthcare to advance human progress.

About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

Role Overview

As a Data Architect, you will lead or support the development of advanced, secure data solutions for innovative digital marketing platforms. You'll craft data strategy, architecture, SQL, and governance for customer solutions spanning end-to-end profiles, segmentation, journeys, and campaigns.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide deep experience building data solutions across multiple Adobe products and cloud platforms aligned with enterprise data strategy
  • Engage closely with customers to facilitate data discovery, evaluating systems and business processes, and analyzing sources, movement, granularity, and format
  • Unify disparate data (sales, CRM, analytics, etc.) to meet digital marketing use cases; lead development of conceptual, logical, and physical data models
  • Define standards for data quality, master data management, data governance, modeling, tooling, security, privacy, and regulatory compliance (PII, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR)
  • Engage cross-disciplinary groups to identify customer demands and provide scalable, secure data blueprints
  • Provide solutions for growing data volumes, tools, and integrations aligned with customer objectives
  • Deliver data lake and real-time customer profile readiness for ingestion/activation, using REST APIs, Postman, and scripting to automate setup
  • Develop data ingestion solutions for streaming and batch processing; collaborate on ETL/ELT pipelines
  • Improve data query performance across platforms while ensuring product guardrails are followed
  • Drive end-to-end data migration initiatives, maintaining data quality, integrity, and compliance

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience
  • 10+ years of data architecture, modeling, and SQL experience working directly with customers
  • Expert proficiency crafting customer-centric database models across relational, hierarchical, and analytical architectures (RDBMS, Columnar, Data Warehouse, BI, Document, Semantic layer, Data Lakes, OLTP & OLAP)
  • Advanced SQL development skills (functions, transformations, arrays, joins, stored procedures, data analysis)
  • Deep experience translating business requirements into scalable data architecture via structured workflow/process analysis
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to balance concurrent customer projects; strong communication skills
  • Hands-on use or administration of Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), including available AI tools
  • Deep domain expertise in one or more industries (retail, telecom, healthcare, automotive, cloud/streaming, etc.)
  • Experience with programming languages (e.g., Python or Bash scripting)
  • Experience planning and executing large-scale data migrations

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Real-Time CDP (RTCDP) certification

Engagement Details

Full-time consulting engagement supporting enterprise data architecture initiatives.

Work Arrangement

Remote, supporting clients across the United States and Canada. Core collaboration hours are aligned to Central Time (CST).

Die Bikeleasing Gruppe ist eine der führenden Anbieter von Employer-Benefits- und Mobilitätslösungen in Deutschland. Mit mehreren spezialisierten Unternehmen, starkem profitablem Wachstum und einer klaren Produktvision befinden wir uns mitten in einer technologischen Transformation: weg von zentralen Legacy-Strukturen, hin zu modernen, domänenorientierten Systemen und einer nachhaltig skalierbaren Engineering-Organisation.
Als Senior Software Developer (gn) übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle in dieser Entwicklung. Du bist nicht nur für die Umsetzung neuer Features verantwortlich, sondern trägst aktiv dazu bei, technische Engpässe abzubauen, bestehende Systeme zu modernisieren und die Delivery-Fähigkeit Deines Teams spürbar zu erhöhen. Was diese Position besonders macht: echter Impact, technische Verantwortung, Remote-first-Arbeiten und die Möglichkeit, Modernisierung und Delivery gleichzeitig voranzubringen, ohne reine Architekturrolle, sondern hands-on im Team.   • Im engen Austausch mit Product Ownern, Tech Leads und Engineers klärst Du fachliche Regeln und technische Abhängigkeiten

deine stärken

  • In modernen Backend-Technologien (z. B. Kotlin, TypeScript, Spring Boot oder vergleichbare Stacks) fühlst Du Dich sicher

  • APIs, Integrationsmuster, Datenmodelle und operative Auswirkungen technischer Entscheidungen sind Dir vertraut
  • Hohe Engineering-Hygiene zeichnen Dich aus: testbares Design, Code-Qualität, Wartbarkeit und Produktionsbewusstsein
  • AI-Tools nutzt Du souverän als Produktivitätshebel, ohne Verantwortung für Qualität und Korrektheit abzugeben

warum zu uns?

Wir leben den Teamspirit: Für uns bist DU wichtig. Jeden Tag leistet unser stetig wachsendes Team Großartiges und wir wollen Dich an unserer Seite. Wir bieten Dir:
  • Du bist Teil des Wachstums, kannst vieles vorantreiben und aktiv mitgestalten – gemeinsam schaffen wir eine starke Karriereperspektive
  • Zurück ins Office? Nicht bei uns! Stattdessen erwartet Dich maximale Flexibilität – Remote-first, unterstützt durch unser modernes Gleitzeitmodell sowie unsere Workation Policy
  • Moderne Tech-Umgebung (u. a. Kotlin, TypeScript, PHP, Python; Spring Boot, Vue.js, React, NestJS, Symfony; AWS & Terraform)

  • Und selbstverständlich kannst Du bis zu zwei Fahrräder oder Pedelecs über uns als Arbeitgeber leasen
Wir sehen Vielfalt als Bereicherung für unser Team. Darum freuen wir uns über alle Bewerbungen und möchten besonders Menschen mit Behinderung oder anderen Herausforderungen dazu ermutigen, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

Working at NLR

NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.

Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.



Job Description

The Power Systems Engineering Center (PSEC) at the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) is inviting applications for one or two internship positions to work on in the area of power systems and power electronics interfaces. This position will perform dynamic modeling and validation of power systems with high percentage of inverter-based resources and evaluate their impact on power grids. This work will be conducted at NREL’s Flatiron Campus. The researcher should have knowledge of power system stability analysis and control theory.

Job responsibilities will include:

  • Provide technical analysis related to power electronics and power systems control of renewable generation, battery energy storage systems, and large industrial drives.
  • Work under supervision to build power system EMT simulation and perform power system validation.
  • Integrating, testing, and using user-written “black box” models in PSCAD for wind turbine generators, solar inverters, battery energy storage systems (BESS), or other advanced power electronic based systems.
  • Evaluate studies that examine the impact of high percentage of inverter-based resource on power systems.
  • Writing and publishing results of analysis in peer-reviewed journals and technical reports
  • Follow all Environmental, Safety, and Health policies to ensure and maintain a safe working environment.

.

Basic Qualifications

Minimum of a 3.0 cumulative grade point average.

Undergraduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a bachelor’s degree program from an accredited institution.
Post Undergraduate: Earned a bachelor’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year.

Graduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a master’s degree program from an accredited institution.
Post Graduate: Earned a master’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year.
Graduate + PhD: Completed master’s degree and enrolled as PhD student from an accredited institution.

Please Note:

• Applicants are responsible for uploading official or unofficial school transcripts, as part of the application process.
• If selected for position, a letter of recommendation will be required as part of the hiring process.
• Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.

* Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.

Additional Required Qualifications

  • Experience with power system EMT software tools such as PSCAD, MATLAB/Simulink, DIgSILENT, RSCAD, or other EMT simulation tools.
  • Solid knowledge on power system EMT modeling, power system stability and control.
  • Solid knowledge on the modeling and control of inverter-based resources.
  • Ability to present technical results to multi-stakeholder audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework or project experience in power system or power electronics modeling.
  • Coursework or project experience using Python, R, or similar programming programing languages.
  • Experience with RTDS modeling and HIL testing.
  • Basic familiarity with EMTP-RV and/or EMTP-ATP.

.

Drug Free Workplace

NLR is committed to maintaining a drug-free workplace in accordance with the federal Drug-Free Workplace Act and complies with federal laws prohibiting the possession and use of illegal drugs. Under federal law, marijuana remains an illegal drug.

If you are offered employment at NLR, you must pass a pre-employment drug test prior to commencing employment. Unless prohibited by state or local law, the pre-employment drug test will include marijuana. If you test positive on the pre-employment drug test, your offer of employment may be withdrawn.

raw.description:
About Us

Simprints is a nonprofit tech company with a mission to radically increase transparency and effectiveness in global development. We build ethical, inclusive digital ID powered by biometrics to verify that health, aid, and services truly reach people. Simprints partners with organizations like Gavi to boost immunization rates in developing countries, Ministries of Health like Ghana on pandemic response, and NGOs like BRAC to deliver maternal healthcare. Studies have shown Simprints increases impact through real-time, precision data, for example increasing maternal health visits by 38% in Bangladesh or accurate HIV tracing by 62% in Malawi. Today we’ve worked in over 17 countries helping deliver health, aid, and finance to >3M people. Our goal is to transform the way the world fights poverty, ensuring that every vaccine, every dollar, and every public good reaches the people who need them most.

Department Overview

Primary Function: The Partnerships team at Simprints is responsible for building and managing key relationships with global health, development, and technology partners. They ensure Simprints’ biometric solutions are effectively integrated into impactful programs, while expanding the organisation’s reach into new markets.

Key Goals:

  • Build and maintain strong, strategic partnerships to drive business development and expand market presence.
  • Collaborate across teams to deliver scalable solutions that meet partner needs.
  • Secure new partnerships and ensure long-term success through strong client engagement.

Join Our Partnerships Talent Pool at Simprints

Are you passionate about building strategic relationships that drive real-world impact? At Simprints, we’re always looking for talented professionals to join our mission of transforming global development through cutting-edge technology. Whether you specialise in business development, grant management, partner engagement, or fundraising, we want to hear from you!

What We Do in Partnerships

Benefits

Life is short. We believe work should be inspirational, meaningful and fun. At Simprints, we’re taking on global development’s biggest challenges, powered by an amazing culture and incredible people. Work with us, and you will grow faster, learn more, and take on great responsibilities with the potential to make lasting change.

People Leadership & Team Development

  • Drive engagement by creating a climate where people are motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives; focus on voice of teammate data (e.g., Engagement & Pulse results), partnering with organization leadership to drive necessary changes.

Brand & Advertiser Campaign Stewardship

  • Ensure assigned brand and advertiser partners receive proactive, end-to-end account stewardship from pre-campaign kickoff through in-flight optimization, post-campaign wrap, and renewal planning.

  • Personally own and steward assigned top-book accounts, acting as a trusted advisor who understands each brand’s business objectives and translates them into actionable campaign strategy.

  • Model and champion a proactive service approach, surfacing insights, flagging risks, and recommending optimizations before clients identify them.

  • Drive retention and investment growth within the assigned portfolio by consistently delivering against campaign objectives and ensuring brand partners can clearly articulate the value they receive.

  • Maintain a consistent cadence of in-flight performance reviews, optimization check-ins, and post-campaign readouts that keep brand partners informed and invested in the partnership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Internal Influence

  • Communicate weekly with internal leadership, including Media Planning, Sales, Analytics, and Product, representing the Account Management team's perspective and ensuring alignment on priorities.

  • Surface client feedback and campaign learnings to the Director of Account Management and cross-functional partners to inform process improvements and product decisions.

  • Partner closely with Media Activation to ensure campaign strategies are properly set up and executed to deliver against advertiser objectives.

  • Work alongside Legal and Finance on advertiser contracts, Insertion Orders, and investment structures, ensuring commercial agreements accurately reflect the campaign structure.

  • Act as a bridge between Sales and Activation, ensuring a smooth handoff from commitment to activation and that client expectations set during the sales process are achievable and honored.

Operational Excellence & Process Development

  • Follow and contribute to account management processes, playbooks, and frameworks, identifying opportunities to improve efficiency and consistency across the portfolio.

  • Hold a high-quality bar for campaign setup, in-flight monitoring, and wrap reporting on all assigned accounts, ensuring executional excellence at every stage of the campaign lifecycle.

  • Identify friction points in the client experience and proactively work with internal partners to resolve issues before they escalate.

  • Use campaign data and client feedback to continuously sharpen the quality of account stewardship, bringing learnings back to the team and to the Director.

  • Maintain strong visibility into the performance of all assigned accounts and use that data to prioritize attention, flag risks early, and surface upsell or renewal opportunities.

  • Bachelor's Degree

  • 4 - 7 years w/4+ years of experience in account management, client services, or campaign management in a media, advertising, or retail & commerce media environment.

  • 1+ years of people management or mentorship experience, with a desire to grow as a people leader

  • Strong familiarity with digital media execution, including how campaigns are structured, trafficked, optimized, and measured across offsite and owned channels.

  • Strong communication and relationship management skills, including the ability to simplify complex campaign information for brand partners and internal stakeholders.

  • Experience managing brand or advertiser relationships directly, including navigating campaign issues, communicating performance, identifying growth opportunities.

  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally and coordinate across Media Activation, Planning, Sales, and Reporting to deliver on campaign commitments.

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret campaign performance data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations for clients and internal teams.

  • Preferred prior experience in retail or commerce media environment.

  • Preferred experience managing accounts with major national brands or advertising agencies.

  • Preferred exposure to Insertion Orders and campaign investment structures in a media or advertising context.

  • Preferred familiarity with retail media measurement, attribution methodologies, and how performance data is communicated to brand partners.

This role combines sales, candidate engagement, and administrative responsibilities. The RL3 supports the recruitment lifecycle through candidate prospecting and job pitching, candidate matching and submissions, placement and extension support, pay package preparation, clinician follow-up, and database management. The RL3 also provides coverage for the assigned Recruiter during absences to maintain continuity of candidate communication and active recruitment activity.

The successful RL3 is proactive, highly organized, sales-minded, and comfortable managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. This individual demonstrates strong communication skills, sound judgment, attention to detail, and a commitment to providing an excellent experience for clinicians and internal partners.

  • Review candidate and job databases to identify potential clinician matches for priority, strategic, and fast-moving opportunities.
  • Gather required candidate information and prepare accurate, complete candidate profiles and submissions for the Account Management team.

  • Manage key administrative functions of the Recruiter’s desk, including preparation of gross profit scratch sheets, candidate and placement documentation, missing timecard follow-up, and other activities necessary to support the recruitment and placement process.
  • Provide coverage for the assigned Recruiter during planned and unplanned absences, maintaining candidate communication, managing active opportunities, and addressing time-sensitive desk needs to ensure continuity of business.

  • Collaborate effectively with Recruitment, Account Management, Contracts, Credentialing, and other internal teams to support successful clinician placements and resolve issues throughout the recruitment lifecycle.
  • Provide a high level of service to clinicians and internal partners by proactively identifying needs, resolving issues, and ensuring timely follow-up throughout the recruitment and placement process.

Qualifications

  • Demonstrated interest in sales, recruiting, and candidate relationship management.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to interact professionally with clinicians and internal partners.
  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to prioritize competing responsibilities and meet established turnaround times.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to accuracy in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  • Self-motivated and proactive, with strong problem-solving skills and the ability to take ownership of assigned responsibilities.

  • Ability to develop a thorough understanding of an assigned Recruiter’s desk, candidate pipeline, priorities, and business needs.

  • Demonstrated alignment with Host Healthcare’s core values and commitment to contributing positively to the team and organization.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

· Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

· An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.

· A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

Abbott's Cancer Diagnostics business was established through the acquisition of Exact Sciences, bringing Exact Sciences' full cancer screening and diagnostics portfolio, including Cologuard, Oncotype DX, Cancerguard, and Oncodetect, into Abbott. Together, we're advancing the early detection of cancer and the precision oncology tools that guide personalized treatment decisions, helping patients and providers act on cancer earlier and more precisely. Our combined portfolio and global reach allow us to bring life-changing diagnostic technology to more patients, providers, and health systems worldwide.

The Opportunity

Working on the Oncology Sales team, the Sr. Regional Oncology Specialist (Sr. ROS) will develop and implement a plan to maximize the utilization of Abbott Cancer Diagnostics products in targeted accounts, while staying within budget, and support the corporate objectives and highlight the delivery of key selling messages. Products may include OncoExTra, OncoDetect (MRD) and RiskGuard (Hereditary Cancer Testing). The Sr. ROS should incorporate a high level of service toward being the best-in-class for an assay provider. The Sr. ROS’s plans are used to solve challenging problems in a dynamic environment. The plans should emphasize developing customer relationships as well as leveraging strong clinical and scientific expertise, key stakeholder insight, and selling approach in highly competitive and complex market. To do this plan, the Lead ROS must have, or be able to quickly develop, a clear understanding of key territory-related clinical/political issues. The Sr. ROS will devote whatever time is necessary to complete objectives outlined in the sales plan.

The Sr. ROS provides information critical to accomplishing our mission to all parties involved in the sales of products. The Sr. ROS will provide direct feedback to individuals so they can make accurate decisions at all levels of the company, such as national, regional, and area teams. The Sr. ROS will work with managed care, reimbursement, patients, to include patient support groups, Abbott Cancer Diagnostics advocacy group, and providers to ensure access to products.

What You’ll Work On

About Anaconda

Be at the center of AI

Anaconda is built to advance AI with open source at scale, giving builders and organizations the confidence to increase productivity, and save time, spend and risk associated with open source. 95% of the Fortune 500 including Panasonic, AmTrust, Booz Allen Hamilton and over 50 million users rely on the value The Anaconda AI Platform delivers through a centralized approach to sourcing, securing, building, and deploying AI. With 21 billion downloads and growing, Anaconda has established itself as the gold standard for Python, data science, and AI and the enterprise-ready solution of choice for AI innovation. Anaconda is backed by world-class investors including Insight Partners. Learn more at .

Summary:

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Revenue Accounting to own the technical revenue accounting function as Anaconda scales from Python-for-data-science company to AI-native platform.

You'll build the revenue processes and technical rigor that allow us to integrate three 2026 acquisitions and scale toward Big Four audit readiness, all while the business is moving fast. This is a hands-on, high-judgment seat where your technical accounting decisions have real operational consequences, not memo-writing in a vacuum. This is an excellent opportunity for you to leverage your experience and skills and apply it to the world of data science, artificial intelligence, and machine learning.

This position reports to the Controller.


What You'll Do:
  • Own ASC 606 technical analysis for new and non-standard deals, including performance obligation identification, standalone selling price analysis, and variable consideration treatment, drafting technical accounting memos that guide how we recognize revenue
  • Determine revenue treatment and billing mechanics for three acquired businesses transitioning from QuickBooks into NetSuite, including one on AWS Marketplace, building integration processes that scale correctly from the start
  • Sit on the deal desk providing real-time revenue guidance to Sales and Legal on non-standard contracts, pricing structures, and hybrid models so deals close with proper revenue treatment baked in
  • Own the quote-to-cash process end-to-end across Salesforce, Nue CPQ, NetSuite, Anrok, and Stripe, improving handoffs and data flow with RevOps as systems evolve
  • Own monthly revenue close, including deferred revenue waterfall reconciliation, deferred commission accounting under ASC 340-40, and ACL/CECL credit loss analysis
  • Lead the revenue recognition thread of external audits, preparing technical memos, workpapers, and sample support that meet Big Four documentation standards
  • Build AI-enabled workflows for your team, such as memo drafting, reconciliation automation, and recurring reporting; that speed technical and operational work as revenue complexity scales
  • Manage and develop the revenue team; currently one direct report

Your Impact Will Be Measured Through:

  • Accuracy, timeliness, and audit-readiness of ASC 606 technical memos and revenue conclusions that guide how we structure and recognize deals
  • Clean, timely revenue recognition and billing integration for acquired businesses with minimal post-close adjustments
  • Turnaround time and quality of real-time deal desk guidance on non-standard contracts, enabling Sales to close deals faster with proper revenue treatment
  • Clean external audit results on revenue with minimal follow-up requests or restatements
  • Measurable improvement in quote-to-cash system accuracy and process efficiency through AI-enabled automation

What You Need:

  • 6+ years progressive revenue accounting experience with hands-on ASC 606 application in SaaS or subscription business models
  • CPA credential strongly preferred
  • Experience with ASC 340-40 deferred commission accounting
  • Demonstrated experience providing deal desk or real-time revenue guidance on complex or non-standard contracts
  • Hands-on experience with quote-to-cash systems including Salesforce, NetSuite, and CPQ or billing platforms such as Nue, Zuora, or Chargebee
  • External audit experience including technical memo writing and workpaper preparation that meets Big Four or national firm standards
  • Experience using AI tools to speed technical accounting or reconciliation work, with readiness to build AI-enabled workflows for a team
  • People management experience or clear readiness to manage and develop a technical accounting team
  • Multi-entity accounting experience navigating legal and operational complexity across business structures
  • Bachelor's degree in Accounting or Finance
  • You embody our values of Clarity, Care and Candor
  • You care deeply about fostering an environment where people of all backgrounds and experiences can flourish
What Will Make You Stand Out:
  • You've integrated revenue systems post-acquisition or handled purchase accounting revenue implications when combining billing platforms
  • You've worked with various billing models, building 606-compliant allocation frameworks for tiered or variable pricing
  • You have Big Four or national accounting firm audit background combined with in-house SaaS operational experience, bringing both technical rigor and practical system fluency
  • You've built AI agents that automate manual review work like comparing dates, dollar amounts, addresses across systems and flags exceptions for human review while auto-approving clean transactions
  • You've worked in fast-paced, high-growth SaaS environments where you built revenue processes proactively rather than fixed mistakes reactively
  • You've worked at open-source, AI, or data science companies where technical products required creative revenue treatment
Why You'll Like Working Here:
  • You'll thrive in a high-performance environment where results are recognized and rewarded
  • Your work directly contributes to shaping the future of data science, machine learning, and AI in the enterprise
  • You'll work alongside a collaborative team that values diverse, thoughtful discussion, clarity and candor
  • You'll be supported by a culture that puts employees first - with flexible hours, a fully remote setup, and a genuine commitment to your wellbeing and growth

The application deadline for this role is 11/17/2026;applicants will be reviewed on an ongoing basis until the role is filled.

Job Summary

We are seeking a Lead Functional SAP MII/ME Consultant to drive the business process design, gap analysis, and global rollout of our digital manufacturing platform. Working with a premier Aerospace & Defense client, you will act as the vital bridge between manufacturing business stakeholders and the technical engineering teams. You will own the functional blueprint for upgrading our existing SAP MII template and implementing end-to-end SAP ME solutions (excluding SCADA layer details), ensuring strict alignment with complex A&D compliance regulations.

  • A&D Regulatory Compliance: Ensure all functional process designs adhere strictly to defense sector mandates, including ITAR tracking, EAR, AS9100 quality standards, and product serialization traceability.

  • Functional Expertise: 10–15+ years of deep functional consulting experience within SAP ME (Manufacturing Execution) and SAP MII.
  • Domain Knowledge: Strong background in discrete manufacturing environments, specifically Aerospace & Defense or highly regulated industries.
  • ERP Integration: Expert understanding of SAP PP (Production Planning) and QM (Quality Management) master data and shop floor execution dependencies.
  • Process Mastery: Proven ability to translate physical shop floor actions (e.g., labor tracking, scrap recording, component consumption) into clean SAP functional steps without relying on SCADA layers.
  • Compliance Frameworks: Familiarity with federal data restrictions, defense infrastructure security, and tracking components under strict regulatory oversight.

Soft Skills & Certifications

  • Elite stakeholder management skills with a proven track record of aligning plant managers, quality engineers, and corporate IT leadership.

  • SAP Certifications preferred and prior Aerospace & Defense (A&D) nice to have

We’re looking for a nimble Senior iOS Developer who wants to see their code used by millions of people around the world. This is an opportunity to work on a fast-growing product with a large user base that is frequently among the Top 10 most downloaded Health and Fitness apps that makes real change in people's lives. Joining us means you’ll be working in our senior level team of iOS Developers and cooperating with an experienced CTO, an award-winning designer, and a team of researchers in one of the most advanced behavioral economics centers.

Do you have great expertise in iOS app development? Do you like to push the technology forward? Do you feel that helping people around the world achieve healthy habits is an important and meaningful mission for you? Then you should join the Fabulous mobile team.

Responsibilities

  • Applying your technical knowledge across all stages of feature development
  • Delivering high quality, modular and testable code, including business logic being shared with Android app using J2Objc tool
  • Taking part in preparing relevant project documentation
  • Creating user interfaces based on mock-ups prepared by our UI/UX designers, including some neat animations
  • Taking part in improving of our processes and standards

Requirements

  • 5 years of programming experience in either Objective-C or Swift
  • Experience developing, releasing and maintaining native iOS applications
  • Experience with Java or willingness to learn
  • Capacity to work efficiently as part of a team; able to give and accept feedback
  • Experience designing clean and maintainable APIs
  • Experience with multithreaded programming
  • Experience writing unit tests and testable code

Nice To Have

  • Author of live production app(s) in AppStore
  • Experience with SwiftUI and modern Swift API design and concurrency patterns (Combine, async await, Actors etc.)
  • Hands on with Java and Android apps
  • Experience with Google Firebase tool

Benefits

About Us

An award-winning health, wellness, & coaching company that creates apps which fall the top ten internationally. Our science-based approach sits squarely in the tech-for-good lane, helping people live their best lives. Everyone who has joined this company is committed to using evidence-based research to find the absolute best ways to change lives for the better.

Our History

Three co-founders created the Fabulous app: Sami, Amine, and Taylor. Growing up in Tunisia, Sami and Amine were only 16 when they met. With their early iteration, they reached out to Taylor, an award-winning designer in Malaysia. Their vision was welcomed into an incubation lab for startups at Duke University led by world-renowned Behavioral Economics Professor Dan Ariely. Our Chief Storyteller Jaz co-founded the Introductory Psychology program at Stanford University.

Our Approach

We use a behavioral economics lens to help individuals find that 'on switch' inside them to achieve their fullest potential. What has emerged is a system that transforms tiny habits into profound long-term changes. A world in which people with ADHD thrive. A method for gratitude to reach through difficulty. A sanctuary to seek out your true purpose. A fountain of knowledge. A space for rest and self compassion.

Our Mission

Help every individual discover the wonderful person inside themselves by creating: beautiful, evidence-based, life-changing products.

Our Environment

The first thing that sets us apart is that we’re not a place at all. While we’re a remote company, it’s not unusual to feel you know your teammates better than those you’ve shared an office with in the past. Ours is a professionally nourishing environment that is flexible and fully remote. Team members enjoy in house challenges and Slack event and work across a variety of tools. Meetings are kept to a minimum and deep work is encouraged.

Our Awards

  • Apple Best Apps of 2018
  • Editor’s app choice in more than 30 countries
  • Winner of Google’s Material Design Award
  • Best App Finalist in Google Play Awards
  • Consistently ranking in the top ten Health & Fitness apps across platforms
  • Backed by Facebook Startup Lab and Microsoft Venture

Our Norms

Ownership: Be the CEO of your tasks. No one is watching over your shoulder. Be the proof.

Open Communication: Constructive ideas are always flying across time zones.

Deep Work: Disconnect. Find your flow. Become industrious. It’s about the work here.

Always Offer Context: Sharing rationale works wonders in asynchronous conversations.

Impeccable Agreement: Promise, then follow through. Everyone relies on everyone.

Egos are checked at the door. Those who join our workforce place themselves in service of our members.

Our Values

#collaboration #craftsmanship #feedback #respect #responsibility #simplicity #speed.

Our Future

To this day, over 30 million people have started their journey to better themselves with our apps. We are creating a generation of change-makers, with the same drive to help others, each in their own way.

Our Invitation

At Fabulous, every team member is a sculptor in their own right. Together, we help millions of users step out of their block of stone and step into the fullest version of their life through behavioral science. Tell us what drives you; if you were to pick up your tools, what would you contribution look like?

The Strategy & Optimization Director, Onmark MSPL, will lead initiatives that optimize performance and drive long-term growth across member practices, aggregator groups, such as Onmark Vision, and other GPO programs and initiatives. This role serves as a strategic liaison between provider organizations and biopharma partners, influencing contract strategies and delivering enhanced economics for member providers. raw.description:
This position has the option to be remote. Candidates must be located in Ohio. Sponsorship is not offered for this position.

Specialty Networks creates clinical and economic value for independent specialty providers and pharmaceutical industry partners across multiple specialties: Urology, Gastroenterology, and Rheumatology. Specialty Networks’ PPS Analytics platform is a commercial SaaS platform that collects data from various clinical and operational practice systems, and uses artificial intelligence and modern data analytics to transform it into meaningful and actionable insights that ensure providers get their patients to the right care at the right time.

The Commercial Technologies Software Engineering team delivers the applications our member practices and pharmaceutical partners depend on. This Software Engineer will design and implement full-stack functionality across our clinical and administrative web applications and the services behind them, working closely with their own team and others.

Our platform is modern and actively evolving, and this role is focused on new development. You will build data-rich, user-facing features in a regulated healthcare environment, increasingly with AI-assisted capabilities, and help take the product through its next stage of evolution. We value engineers who can turn ambiguous product direction into well-built, maintainable software.

This is a hands-on role with the potential to grow into a technical leadership scope. You will be a primary contributor and may also set technical direction and guide the day-to-day work of a small team that includes contract engineers. That leadership is technical rather than people management: you would lead the work and raise the bar of what the team ships, without carrying HR responsibility for it.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement full-stack functionality across our web applications, from the API and data layer through the user interface
  • Build the interfaces users work in day to day, from interactive dashboards to workflow tools
  • Design configurable, data-driven feature logic so product behavior can be adapted without code changes
  • Integrate AI- and analytics-assisted capabilities, building for results that are explainable and traceable to their source
  • Author well-structured, reusable UI components, and build and consume RESTful APIs and the serverless functions behind our integrations
  • May provide technical direction to a small team of engineers, including contract resources: breaking work into clear, well-specified tasks, reviewing code, and upholding our engineering standards
  • Write secure, privacy-conscious code in line with our HIPAA obligations and application-security standards, and contribute to automated testing
  • Keep our applications current as frameworks and platform standards evolve, and debug and resolve issues across the stack
  • Mentor developers, act as a QA resource, and collaborate across engineering and non-technical teams
  • Assist with software releases and build and release automation

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent work experience, preferred
  • 7+ years of full-stack software development with C# and a modern component-based JavaScript framework, preferred
  • Experience leading projects technically and guiding the work of other engineers, including contract or partner resources, as a technical lead rather than a people manager; able to scope and specify work clearly enough for others to execute
  • Expert-level C# with ASP.NET Core, and expert-level Angular and TypeScript
  • Strong experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs
  • Solid Entity Framework Core and SQL Server skills, with comfort dropping to hand-written SQL (for example, Dapper) when performance calls for it
  • Experience building data-driven, configurable feature logic (rules engines or similarly parameterized behavior) rather than one-off hard-coded flows
  • Experience building data-forward interfaces such as dashboards, reporting, or search and filtering over sizable datasets
  • Hands-on experience building and operating applications on Microsoft Azure: App Services, Azure Functions, Key Vault, and Application Insights; authentication with Azure AD B2C and MSAL; and Azure DevOps for CI/CD
  • A security-conscious approach to code, and experience meeting quality and application-security standards in a regulated or enterprise setting
  • A strong communicator, comfortable with ambiguity and evolving requirements, and a collaborative problem-solver

Preferred:

  • Healthcare or clinical application development in a HIPAA-regulated, PHI-handling environment
  • Integrating AI or LLM-backed capabilities with attention to grounding, citation, or explainability
  • Clinical decision support, guideline- or protocol-driven logic, or other rules-based domain modeling
  • Multi-tenant SaaS and tenant data isolation
  • Working with distributed, offshore, or contract engineering teams
  • Component-driven frontend architecture, and third-party or vendor data integrations
  • Performance and application performance monitoring (APM) tooling, and familiarity with security and compliance frameworks (SAST, SOC 2, or HITRUST)
  • Legacy application migration and modernization

Anticipated Pay Range: $94,900 - $135,600

Bonus Eligible: No

Benefits: Cardinal Health offers a wide variety of benefits and programs to support health and well-being.

  • Medical, dental and vision coverage
  • Paid time off plan
  • Health savings account (HSA)
  • 401k savings plan
  • Access to wages before pay day with myFlexPay
  • Flexible spending accounts (FSAs)
  • Short- and long-term disability coverage
  • Work-Life resources
  • Paid parental leave
  • Healthy lifestyle programs

Senior Gameplay Engineer

Astrid is a gaming studio that brings together accomplished worldbuilders and game developers to create multiplayer creative experiences. Our first project is a cooperative open-world sim, designed to foster connection, problem-solving, and shared discovery. Players embark on a profound social experience in a richly imagined world shaped by dynamic systems, immersive storytelling, and community-driven play.

Our team spans the US, the UK, and beyond. We are taking a fully remote approach, but have regular in-person meetups to synchronise, huddle and build our culture.

The Role

Astrid is seeking an experienced Senior UI / Gameplay Systems Engineer to join our small and thoughtful team as we push the boundaries in gaming and IP, offering fans new meaningful worlds and experiences.

We are looking for an experienced engineer with a strong focus on UI and gameplay systems, having built player-facing features within Unreal Engine 5 using Blueprint and C++, and with extensive experience building UIs in UMG — ideally with CommonUI. You are comfortable working within and extending established gameplay architectures, and you care about delivering intuitive experiences that support core game flows and gameplay systems.

This is a remote position on a fully distributed team.

Who You Are

  • You are passionate about games and what they mean for our players
  • You are proactive and take initiative
  • You are a problem solver with a positive mindset who likes a challenge
  • You care about code quality
  • You consistently address issues as you encounter them
  • You like to experiment and innovate
  • You work well with others and communicate technical concepts clearly
  • You have a continuous improvement mindset

What You Will Do

  • Build and design player-facing menus, UI, and HUD systems using C++ and Blueprint
  • Design intuitive interfaces using UMG and CommonUI
  • Integrate with existing gameplay systems, and develop new gameplay systems for an open-world simulation game
  • Share knowledge, mentor, and support colleagues in your area of expertise
  • Champion engineering quality
  • Partner with engineers, designers and artists to deliver excellent player-facing features

Requirements

  • Proven experience developing UI and gameplay systems in Unreal Engine 5.
  • Strong understanding of UMG.
  • Working knowledge of CommonUI, CommonInput, Enhanced Input, and how the systems interact.
  • Strong teamwork and collaboration skills.
  • Solid knowledge of C++
  • Experience identifying and addressing performance bottlenecks in UI and gameplay systems

Benefits

  • Great compensation package and equity
  • Private health insurance
  • Pension
  • Unlimited vacation days. We trust our team!
  • Flexible remote work hours as long as team members deliver results
  • We are committed to continuing to expand our benefits and perks to support our team.

Bonus Experience

  • Knowledge of Slate
  • Experience developing systemic games (emergent mechanics, interlocking systems, simulation-driven worlds, sandbox or co-op titles)
  • Experience in social, frontend, and gameplay-adjacent areas of game development
  • Familiarity with developing games for multiple platforms

Job Description:

About the Team:
The People team at Dow Jones is dedicated to attracting, developing, and retaining world-class talent that drives our mission forward. As strategic partners, we provide comprehensive support across the entire employee lifecycle. Our team includes Talent Acquisition, Talent Management, People Business Partners, Compensation, HR Operations, Workplace, and Security—all working together to create an exceptional employee experience. We champion a culture of inclusion, innovation, and excellence, ensuring our people have the resources, support, and opportunities they need to thrive and do their best work.

About Global Risk, Security & Resilience

The Global Risk, Security and Resilience team is responsible for managing the company’s operational risks and advising the business on other commercial, strategic or reputational challenges that may arise. With functions covering audits & investigations, business resilience (incident & crisis management, business continuity), digital risk, event security, global operations & insights, health, safety & wellness, high risk & newsroom safety and workplace security, the department covers a diverse technical portfolio leveraged to ensure risks are reasonably managed, security threats addressed and disruptions limited in support of Dow Jones’ strategic goals.

About the Role

The Associate, Event Security is an ad-hoc security resource supporting corporate events and high-visibility functions across the United States and, as needed, internationally.

Reporting to the Manager, Event Security & Investigations, the advisor will be available to support any events geographically in the United States and abroad on a needed basis. In instances where travel is required, prior notice will be given for the scheduled event. The position is paid on an hourly basis for all work performed applicable to the event security operations process. Location: United States (West Coast preferred; remote with travel as required).

You Will

  • Support the growth and development of event security processes and procedures.

  • Conduct structured risk assessments for corporate events and high-visibility functions to identify threat exposure, operational vulnerabilities, and mitigation requirements.

    • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a remote consultancy setup.

Job Description

The STAGES Sign Language Interpreter -CONTRACTOR is responsible for interpreting or transliterating all academic content to allow students who are D/HH to access instruction, communicate with other members of the school community, and participate in school-based activities. The scope of services and supports provided by the Educational Interpreter will be determined by the students’ Individualized Education Plans (IEPs). The Educational Interpreter serves as a collaborative member of a team that supports students identified as D/HH in a virtual academic environment and are fluent in American Sign Language (ASL). The Sign Language Interpreter- Contractor may be asked to obtain licensure in multiple states and serve students across multiple schools.

This is an Independent Consultant position (1099).

This is a Part-Time position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Experience using one or more signing systems in an educational setting, including American Sign Language (ASL), Manually Coded English, Conceptually Accurate Signed English (CASE), and/or Finger Spelling
  • Interpret and transliterate content presented in the live, synchronous virtual academic setting as delineated in the assigned students’ IEPs
  • Adapt language and materials to meet the individual needs of students with hearing loss
  • Collaborate with other members of the school community (e.g., general education teachers, special education teachers, caregivers, related service providers) to share information regarding students’ progress and needs, as well as to ensure services are delivered in compliance with IEPs
  • Serve as an integral member of the IEP team and attend IEP meetings
  • Provide expressive and voice interpretation of classroom instruction, clarify curricular content, support work completion, and provide language support in small groups or during one-on-one interactions
  • Interpret for school activities outside of the virtual classroom, extracurricular activities, and meetings with caregivers
  • Adhere to professional standards as outlined in the Code of Ethics of the National Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf
  • Serve as a liaison between students who are D/HH, hearing peers, staff, community members, and/or caregivers
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with students, caregivers, and school staff
  • Be available to students, caregivers, and staff during designated work hours
  • Work from a professional home office environment, conducive to video and audio needs and a structured schedule
  • Must be self-motivated, dependable, creative, and passionate about meeting the needs of students
  • Prior experience supporting students identified as D/HH in the academic environment is desired but not required.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum 1 year experience interpreting in educational environment and

Minimum 1 year experience providing interpreting services virtually

Certificates and Licenses:

National Interpreter Certification issued by the Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf and/or

State specific educational interpreter licensure

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to work independently, with availability during typical school hours of at least 20 hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9 - 5 as defined by the school and time zone
  • Strong content and subject-matter knowledge
  • An ability to support and guide adults as well as students
  • Receptive to receiving coaching on a regular basis with administrators
  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes
  • Ability to create and deliver staff development
  • Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms
  • MS365 Proficient
  • Ability to clear required background check

This position is remote and open to residents of the 50 states and D.C. This is an Independent Consultant position (1099).

Assessment Scientist Core Responsibilities

eCOA Management (Endpoint Scale Implementation & UAT)

  • Lead scientific oversight of eCOA implementation, ensuring accurate translation of endpoint scales into digital platforms with full fidelity to protocol and scoring requirements
  • Drive development and review of eCOA specifications, partnering with vendors to deliver high-quality, fit-for-purpose system design
  • Own UAT strategy, including authoring and reviewing test scripts to validate endpoint logic, workflows, and data integrity

  • Lead global scale licensing and copyright strategy, ensuring compliant and efficient use of clinical outcome assessments
  • Ensure accurate scale selection, version control, and implementation aligned with protocol-defined endpoints
  • Oversee translation strategy and vendor execution, ensuring high-quality, culturally appropriate instruments across regions
  • Drive consistency across source scales, translations, and eCOA/eCRF implementations to protect endpoint integrity

Rater Training (Endpoint Reliability & Standardization)

  • Design and deliver tailored rater training programs to ensure high-quality, standardized endpoint data collection across sites
  • Define rater qualification standards and support selection of experienced, study-ready site personnel
  • Develop and deploy engaging training and certification programs to drive consistency in scale administration and scoring
  • Monitor rater performance and lead targeted remediation to minimize variability and protect endpoint reliability

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, specifically: Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
• Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment
• Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both written and spoken, with an ability to inform, influence, convince, and persuade
• Strong presentation skills, with experience presenting in professional settings.
• Ability to travel as necessary (approximately 20%).

Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.

No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.

Our vision for the future is based on the idea that transforming financial lives starts by giving our people the freedom to transform their own. We have a flexible work environment, and fluid career paths. We not only encourage but celebrate internal mobility. We also recognize the importance of purpose, well-being, and work-life balance. Within Empower and our communities, we work hard to create a welcoming and inclusive environment, and our associates dedicate thousands of hours to volunteering for causes that matter most to them.

Chart your own path and grow your career while helping more customers achieve financial freedom. Empower Yourself.

Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time, including CPT/OPT.

The Data Architect will serve as a hands-on technical expert and solution architecture contributor, helping design Empower’s cloud and data architecture. This role will partner with enterprise architects, senior architects, business leaders, IT teams, and Empower’s Innovation Lab to shape solution architectures, support modernization initiatives, explore emerging technologies including Generative AI and Advanced Analytics, and translate experimentation into practical patterns and recommendations for delivery teams.

What you will do:

  • Partner with Enterprise Architects, Senior Architects, and cross functional teams, including business stakeholders, to shape solution architectures aligned to a unified IT data strategy.

  • Contribute to Empower’s technology roadmap by documenting target state architectures, reference architectures, and key dependencies for supported initiatives.

  • Design and support modernization and migration of complex systems to scalable, secure, and cost optimized cloud architectures, working with delivery teams through implementation.

  • Evaluate and prototype new technologies and applications, challenge existing approaches constructively, and provide input into business cases and recommendations.

  • Apply and help operationalize architectural standards, best practices, and governance expectations, supporting consistent adoption through guidance and enablement.

  • Collaborate closely with business and engineering teams to design end to end solutions that meet strategic, technical, and operational objectives.

  • Provide architectural guidance in process design, system orchestration, and enterprise integration to enable cohesive and efficient technology ecosystems.

  • Champion security, resilience, and scalability as core design principles across data platforms and data solutions.

  • Contribute to architecture discipline maturity by producing reusable patterns, decision documentation, and lessons learned that improve consistency and delivery speed.

  • Support full stack development teams through solution design and implementation, improving long term scalability, performance, and cost outcomes.

What you will bring:

  • Bachelor’s and/or master’s degree in computer science or related field, such as information systems, mathematics, or software engineering, or equivalent experience.

  • At least 5 years of experience delivering data-intensive solutions, for example in data engineering, analytics engineering, data platforms, BI, or related roles.

  • At least 1 year of demonstrated solution design ownership for moderately complex initiatives, gained as an architect or as a senior engineer or technical lead responsible for end-to-end design, architectural trade-offs, and guiding implementation.

  • Proven experience in multiple data focused roles, including Data Engineer, ETL/ELT, Data Architect, Database Administrator, BI or Analytics Engineer, Data Science, data governance, or a similar field.

  • Competency in architecture frameworks, performance optimization, and addressing cross cutting concerns including availability, caching, monitoring, scalability, and security.

  • Strong problem solving and strategic thinking, with the ability to influence cross functional teams and communicate architecture decisions clearly in distributed environments.

  • Strong expertise in designing data and cloud architecture, AWS preferred, supporting scalability, performance, and security with systems such as Snowflake or Redshift.

  • Proven ability to translate complex data into actionable business insights and reporting solutions that provide comprehensive and up to date information to business users.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

What will set you apart:

  • Data engineering experience designing and delivering ETL and ELT pipelines, including orchestration, data quality controls, and reliable operations for batch and near real time workloads.

  • Streaming and event driven data experience building and operating Kafka or Kinesis based architectures, including ordering, replay, schema evolution, and real time observability.

  • API and integration experience designing API first data access patterns, API lifecycle governance, versioning, security, and developer enablement, plus event driven integration patterns to reduce point to point complexity.

  • Data platform modernization experience designing large scale ingestion and processing platforms using Spark or comparable distributed compute and orchestrating reliable batch and near real time pipelines.

  • Data security and privacy experience implementing encryption, masking or tokenization, access controls, and auditability patterns for sensitive data and regulated environments.

  • Cloud cost and performance experience applying FinOps practices, workload right sizing, storage optimization, and performance engineering for cloud data platforms.

  • DevOps for data experience building CI/CD for data pipelines, infrastructure as code practices, and container platforms such as Kubernetes or EKS for data workloads.

  • Applied AI and GenAI experience designing safe enterprise patterns for retrieval, evaluation, monitoring, and responsible AI adoption.

  • Broad polyglot engineering experience with Java, microservices patterns, and third party API integrations that support data intensive services.

  • Certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Associate or Professional.

The Intake and Precertification Specialist – Home Health and Hospice is responsible for managing intake, insurance authorization and administrative coordination of patient referrals for Home Health and Hospice Services. This role ensures timely and accurate prior authorizations, maintains documents, monitors certification deadlines, supports denial management and facilitate communication between patients, providers and internal teams to ensure efficient service delivery and compliance with payer requirement.

1. High School Diploma or equivalent.

EXPERIENCE

CORE DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES: The statements described here are intended to describe the general nature of work being performed by people assigned to this position. They are not intended to be constructed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities and duties. Other duties may be assigned.

1. Coordinate the intake process for new patient referrals, including receiving referral information from healthcare providers, performing insurance verification and scheduling initial assessments.

2. Serves as the primary point of contact for patients, families, referral sources and healthcare professionals regarding referral and authorization status.

11. Track referral activity and ensure timely processing to support admission and billing.

12. Communicate with internal departments regarding authorization status and referral progress.

14. Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously while maintaining accuracy, efficiency and timeliness.

15. Consistently meets required turnaround times and deadlines related to referral processing, authorization and documentation.
